nodes.name: TableRowDef
nodes.summary: Structural directive capturing the consumer's row template for projection into the table body.

nodes.name: TableGroupDef
nodes.summary: Structural directive capturing the consumer's group-header template for collapsible row groups.

nodes.name: Table
nodes.summary: The app-table component: signal-based column/row inputs, cycling three-state sort with sortChange output, collapsed-group tracking, and computed visible rows.

nodes.name: toast-host.ts
nodes.summary: Renders active toast notifications with auto-dismiss timers, hover pause/resume, action buttons, and severity-derived icons and tones.

nodes.name: ToastHost
nodes.summary: Angular component syncing per-toast dismiss timers with the Notifications service's toast signal, pausing on hover, running toast actions, and mapping severity to icon and tone.

nodes.name: tooltip-trigger.ts
nodes.summary: appTooltip directive that shows a CDK-overlay tooltip bubble on hover, honouring the accessibility tooltip setting, per-element disabling, and disabled host elements.

nodes.name: TooltipTrigger
nodes.summary: Directive creating a flexible-connected CDK overlay on show, attaching the Tooltip component with the trigger's text, and disposing the overlay on leave, disable, or destroy.

nodes.name: tooltip.ts
nodes.summary: Presentational tooltip bubble component that renders the tooltip text inside the overlay created by TooltipTrigger.

nodes.name: Tooltip
nodes.summary: Minimal component exposing a text input rendered as the tooltip bubble's content.

nodes.name: tree-view.ts
nodes.summary: Shared tree-view component rendering pre-flattened rows with optional CDK virtual scrolling, scroll-to-selection reveal, indent levels, and per-row context menus.
nodes.languageNotes: Reads the row height from a CSS custom property at runtime (rowHeightPx) so the virtual-scroll itemSize tracks the theme instead of hardcoding pixels.

nodes.name: TreeView
nodes.summary: Angular component emitting rowClick/rowDoubleClick/contextMenuSelect events, computing indent per row, and using afterRenderEffect to scroll the selected row into view in both virtual and non-virtual modes.

nodes.name: agent-edit-preview.ts

nodes.name: AgentEditPreview
nodes.summary: Opens and closes a dock diff panel previewing an agent's edit to a file, registering the panel and pushing the diff into the Diffs store.

nodes.name: api-agent-capabilities.ts
nodes.summary: Exposes the API Explorer's capabilities to the AI agent as tools: listing, creating, updating, and sending requests, setting environment variables, and resolving collections against the workspace.

nodes.name: ApiAgentCapabilities
nodes.summary: Registers the API Explorer's agent tool surface: list/create/update/send requests, set environment variables, and resolve collections, translating between agent payloads and workspace models.

nodes.name: api-explorer-status.ts
nodes.summary: Status-strip contribution for the API Explorer tab, describing the active environment and request state in the application's status bar.

nodes.name: ApiExplorerStatus
nodes.summary: Status-strip component describing the API Explorer's active environment and trailing request outcome.

nodes.name: api-explorer-view.ts
nodes.summary: Root tool-view component for the API Explorer tab: hosts a full dock container via a blueprint, registers agent hosts and commands, and coordinates saving, sending, and creating requests, collections, and environments.
nodes.languageNotes: First tool view to embed the shared dock framework as its body via DOCK_BLUEPRINT providers.

nodes.name: ApiExplorerView
nodes.summary: Dock-hosting tab view that provides the API Explorer's dock blueprint and services, tracks dirty documents, and implements save, send, and new-request/collection/environment commands.

nodes.name: api-explorer.feature.ts
nodes.summary: Feature descriptor contributing the API Explorer tab, its ribbon, and its status strip to the application shell through the lazy featureContributions seam.
nodes.languageNotes: Lazy feature contribution keeps the API Explorer in its own code-split chunk.

nodes.name: api-http.ts
nodes.summary: Thin renderer-side HTTP client for the API Explorer that sends and cancels requests over the IPC bridge to the main-process engine.

nodes.name: ApiHttp
nodes.summary: Sends and cancels API requests through the IPC bridge to the main-process HTTP engine, logging failures.

nodes.name: api-prompts.ts
nodes.summary: Manages the inline naming prompts for creating API collections and environments, holding open/confirm/cancel state as signals.

nodes.name: ApiPrompts
nodes.summary: Holds the open/name state for collection and environment naming prompts with confirm and cancel flows.

nodes.name: api-request-opener.ts
nodes.summary: Opens an API request as a dock panel in the API Explorer's dock, registering the panel and retitling it when the request is renamed.

nodes.name: ApiRequestOpener
nodes.summary: Opens an API request panel in the dock (or focuses an existing one) and retitles it when the request name changes.

nodes.name: dock-tab-group.ts
nodes.summary: Tab group chrome for a dock stack: renders tabs with overflow menus, tool and status strips, and drives activate, close, pin, float, pop-out, and single-tab and whole-group drags.

nodes.name: DockTabGroup
nodes.summary: Tab-strip chrome for a dock stack: tab rendering and overflow, activate/close/pin, float and pop-out requests, and initiation of tab and group drags.

nodes.name: modal-backdrop-view.ts
nodes.summary: Renders the window-scoped modal backdrop element whose visibility is driven by the ModalBackdrop service.

nodes.name: ModalBackdropView
nodes.summary: Minimal component binding the ModalBackdrop service's state to the backdrop element.

nodes.name: modal-window-host.ts

nodes.name: ModalWindowHost
nodes.summary: Renders the configured modal content component inside an Electron modal child window and measures it so the OS window can be sized to fit.

nodes.name: diff-document-panel.ts

nodes.name: DiffDocumentPanel
nodes.summary: Dock panel showing a document diff with inline/side-by-side toggle, previous/next change navigation, and file status display.

nodes.name: PopoutDockHost
nodes.summary: Marker component whose providers assemble a complete window-scoped dock (state, geometry, drag, floating, auto-hide, focus, reveal) plus CDK layer and modal backdrop for a pop-out window.

nodes.summary: Handles pointer drags on a pane divider, translating movement into new flex sizes committed to dock state.

nodes.name: dock-state.ts
nodes.summary: The dock's central state service: holds the layout tree signal, exposes immutable mutations (tab, split, edge-dock, well and stack operations, undo/redo), and persists and restores layouts under the blueprint's key.
nodes.languageNotes: Every mutation replaces the tree signal with a structurally shared copy so dependent views re-render with stable node ids.

nodes.name: dock-tab-context.ts
nodes.summary: Carries the identity of the tab hosting a dock instance — tab id, root folder, and display name — to the panels projected inside it, scoped per dock host.

nodes.name: dock-test-blueprint.ts
nodes.summary: Test-only dock blueprint that reuses the workspace default layout with neutral placeholder panels, letting dock specs exercise mechanics without pulling in feature panels.

nodes.name: dock-tree.ts
nodes.summary: Pure functional core of the dock layout tree: structural-sharing queries and mutations covering node find/replace/remove, tab and split operations, edge docking, stack lifting and reseating, well occupancy, and the default workspace layout.
nodes.languageNotes: All mutations return structurally shared copies of the immutable tree, which is what keeps undo/redo and signal-driven re-render cheap.

nodes.name: popout-panels.ts
nodes.summary: Pop-out seam for a view's dock: registers the single handler that can pop panels into their own OS windows and tracks which panels are currently popped, so reveal focuses the window instead of the dock.

nodes.name: issue-opener.ts
nodes.summary: Opens a forge issue as a document tab in the dock well, reusing the tab when the issue is already open, lazily loading its comments, and creating a well when the layout has none.

nodes.name: modal-backdrop.ts
nodes.summary: Counts the modals open over a window so its content dims, blurs, and stops taking input until every modal is gone; a backdrop click is routed to the topmost modal alone.
nodes.languageNotes: One instance exists per window that can raise modals, so a modal raised from a popped-out panel dims that window rather than the main one.

nodes.name: panel-popout.ts
nodes.summary: Orchestrates popping dock panels into auxiliary OS windows: opens and tracks pop-out windows, routes drops between the main dock and pop-out windows, reconciles state on window close, and returns panels to their origin in the main layout.

nodes.name: window-scope.ts
nodes.summary: Builds the window-scoped Angular CDK providers (overlay container, keyboard/outside-click dispatchers, drag-drop registry, scrolling and viewport ruler) a secondary window needs so menus, dropdowns, and drags work inside it.
nodes.languageNotes: CDK resolves these services through the triggering element's injector, so providing them on the pop-out host component scopes them to that window's document.

nodes.name: api-client-channels.ts
nodes.summary: Names the API Explorer's IPC channels — the feature's slice of the renderer-to-main contract for sending and aborting HTTP requests over the generic bridge transport.
nodes.languageNotes: Requests run in the main process deliberately: the renderer's browser context would apply CORS, block forbidden headers, and hide redirect chains.

nodes.name: api-client-types.ts
nodes.summary: Domain types of the API Explorer shared by the renderer view and the main-process request engine: HTTP methods, request/auth/header shapes, outcomes, and the saved API document format.
nodes.languageNotes: Framework-free by design — nothing depends on Angular or Electron so both halves compile against the same shapes.

nodes.name: network-locations.ts
nodes.summary: Network-location allowlist logic for agent-driven API requests: normalises, sanitises, validates, and matches user-configured host patterns, with cloud-metadata hosts hard-denied regardless of configuration.
nodes.languageNotes: Loopback is deliberately allowed — testing localhost services is the API Explorer's most common use — while the cloud-metadata pivot hosts are always refused.

nodes.name: DockState
nodes.summary: Central dock state service exposing the layout tree signal and immutable mutation methods for tab, split, edge, well, and stack operations plus undo/redo and layout persistence.

nodes.name: DockTabContext
nodes.summary: Per-dock-host context service exposing the owning tab's id, root path, and display name as signals for projected panels.

nodes.name: PopoutPanels
nodes.summary: Service registering the pop-out capability handler and tracking which panels are popped into their own OS windows.

nodes.name: IssueOpener
nodes.summary: Service opening a forge issue as a dock document tab, reusing open tabs, loading comments, and creating a document well when the layout lacks one.

nodes.name: ModalBackdrop
nodes.summary: Service counting open modals over a window and routing backdrop dismiss requests to the topmost modal.

nodes.name: PanelPopout
nodes.summary: Service orchestrating panel pop-out lifecycle: opening auxiliary windows, tracking popped panels, handling cross-window drops, reconciling closed windows, and restoring panels to the main dock.

nodes.name: findNode
nodes.summary: Depth-first search returning the node with a given id, or null.

nodes.name: findStackOfPanel
nodes.summary: Finds the stack node containing a given panel id.

nodes.name: firstStackOfRole
nodes.summary: Finds the first stack carrying a given role (for example the document well).

nodes.name: collectPanelIds
nodes.summary: Collects every panel id referenced anywhere in a tree.

nodes.name: countStacks
nodes.summary: Counts the stack nodes in a tree.

nodes.name: replaceNode
nodes.summary: Returns a structurally shared copy of the tree with one node replaced.

nodes.name: removeNode
nodes.summary: Removes a node from the tree, collapsing single-child splits it leaves behind.

nodes.name: findPrimaryStack
nodes.summary: Finds the tree's primary stack, the anchor for well and default placement decisions.

nodes.name: pruneStack
nodes.summary: Removes a stack after its last panel leaves, with role-aware rules keeping the document well alive.

nodes.name: occupyWell
nodes.summary: Places a panel into the document well, creating or reusing the well stack.

nodes.name: splitWellBeside
nodes.summary: Opens a new well stack split beside the existing one and places a panel in it.

nodes.name: tabInto
nodes.summary: Adds a panel as a tab of an existing stack and activates it.

nodes.name: setActive
nodes.summary: Sets the active tab of a stack.

nodes.name: setCollapsed
nodes.summary: Marks a stack collapsed or expanded, adjusting sibling sizes for the in-place collapse.

nodes.name: splitStack
nodes.summary: Splits a target stack on a side, placing a panel in the new sibling stack.

nodes.name: dockNodeEdge
nodes.summary: Docks an arbitrary node against a workspace edge, wrapping the root in a new split.

nodes.name: removeFromLayout
nodes.summary: Removes a panel from wherever it lives in the tree, pruning its stack if emptied.

nodes.name: reorderTab
nodes.summary: Moves a tab to a new index within its stack, preserving the active panel.

nodes.name: movePanel
nodes.summary: Moves a panel between stacks — tab-into, split, or edge target — as one structural operation.

nodes.name: tabStackInto
nodes.summary: Merges a whole stack's panels into another stack as tabs.

nodes.name: occupyWellWithStack
nodes.summary: Moves a whole stack's panels into the document well.

nodes.name: splitStackBeside
nodes.summary: Splits a target with a whole lifted stack, reseating it beside the target.

nodes.name: dockStackEdge
nodes.summary: Docks a whole lifted stack against a workspace edge.

nodes.name: setSizes
nodes.summary: Applies new proportional sizes to a split node's children.

nodes.name: defaultLayout
nodes.summary: Builds the default workspace layout: File Explorer, document well, Output/Error List, and Agent stacks.

nodes.name: windowScopedCdkProviders
nodes.summary: Builds the provider array giving a secondary window its own CDK overlay, drag-drop, and scrolling infrastructure scoped to that window's document.

nodes.name: normaliseNetworkLocation
nodes.summary: Reduces a user-typed network location to the lower-cased host pattern it names, preserving wildcards.

nodes.name: sanitizeNetworkLocations
nodes.summary: Normalises and de-duplicates a configured list of network locations, dropping unusable entries.

nodes.name: isValidNetworkLocation
nodes.summary: Checks whether a typed network location yields a usable host pattern.

nodes.name: expandNetworkLocations
nodes.summary: Expands configured locations into the concrete pattern set used for matching.

nodes.name: matchesNetworkLocation
nodes.summary: Tests a request host against a host pattern, handling exact matches, ports, and wildcard subdomains.

nodes.name: isNetworkLocationAllowed
nodes.summary: Decides whether a request host is allowed: always-denied metadata hosts are refused, then the user's configured patterns are consulted.

nodes.name: networkLocationRefusal
nodes.summary: Builds the human-readable refusal message explaining why a network location was denied.

nodes.name: dock-auto-hide.ts
nodes.summary: Manages auto-hidden (unpinned) dock stacks: pins and unpins stacks, captures the pixel size a stack occupied when it collapsed, and drives the peek flyout that temporarily overlays a collapsed stack.

nodes.name: dock-blueprint.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the DockBlueprint interface and DOCK_BLUEPRINT injection token: the host-supplied configuration naming the panels a dock instance can show and the layout it starts and resets with, so different tab kinds reuse the same dock framework.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses an Angular InjectionToken so each dock host tab can provide its own blueprint; a factory default runs before the consuming service constructor body.

nodes.name: dock-drag.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the dock's drag engine for tabs and whole stacks: arming and activating drags, hit-testing drop guides against dock geometry, resolving edge/group/compass targets, previewing the drop, and applying single-panel or group docking on release.

nodes.name: dock-floating.ts
nodes.summary: Manages floating dock windows: floats a panel out of the layout tree, moves and resizes floats with minimum-size clamping, maintains z-order, and docks a float back into the tree.

nodes.name: dock-focus.ts
nodes.summary: Tracks which dock stack currently has focus so only the focused stack's panel renders the accent border while the others stay neutral.

nodes.name: dock-geometry.ts
nodes.summary: Registers the on-screen rectangles of dock groups and the workspace, supporting hit-tests that map pointer positions to groups and rects during drag operations.

nodes.name: dock-legality.ts
nodes.summary: Pure geometry and legality rules for dock drops: nearest-edge detection, guide legality, edge and split previews, and resolution of edge, group, and compass-guide drop targets from pointer positions.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately stateless pure functions over Rect values, keeping drop-target maths independently testable from the drag service.

nodes.name: dock-node.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the dock layout tree's node model — stack and split nodes with sides, roles and sizes — plus node id generation and reservation, factory helpers, and type guards.

nodes.name: dock-panel-availability.ts
nodes.summary: Tracks per-view availability of dock panels so a saved layout keeps naming unavailable panels while rendering simply skips them until the thing backing each panel exists.
nodes.languageNotes: Availability filters at render time rather than rewriting the layout tree, so saved layouts never silently lose panels.

nodes.name: dock-panel-registry.ts
nodes.summary: Catalogue of the dock panels a view can host, seeded from the blueprint's panel list; resolves panel descriptors by identifier for the dock chrome and drag machinery.

nodes.name: dock-persistence.ts
nodes.summary: Restores a persisted dock layout from untrusted storage: validates the tree's structure, prunes panels the session can no longer show, and reserves restored node ids so new ones cannot collide.
nodes.languageNotes: Sanitises on read rather than write, making restoreLayout the single authority on what survives a schema change.

nodes.name: dock-reveal.ts
nodes.summary: Reveals a panel wherever it currently lives — expanded stack, collapsed peek, floating window, or popped-out OS window — so programmatic flows can surface a panel without knowing its state.

nodes.name: DockAutoHide
nodes.summary: Service managing unpinned dock stacks: pin/unpin, peek-size capture, and showing/hiding the peek flyout for collapsed stacks.

nodes.name: DockDrag
nodes.summary: Drag engine service: arms and activates tab and group drags, tracks pointer movement against dock geometry, resolves and previews drop targets, and applies the dock on release.

nodes.name: DockFloating
nodes.summary: Service owning floating dock windows: float, move, resize with minimum bounds, bring-to-front, close, and dock-back operations.

nodes.name: DockFocus
nodes.summary: Signal-backed tracker of the focused dock stack id, driving the accent border on the focused stack.

nodes.name: DockGeometry
nodes.summary: Service tracking registered group and workspace rectangles and answering geometric queries (rectOf, groupAt) used for drag hit-testing.

nodes.name: DockPanelAvailability
nodes.summary: Service holding a per-view map of panel availability; unlisted panels are treated as available.

nodes.name: DockPanelRegistry
nodes.summary: Registry of the panels this dock can host, seeded from the blueprint, with lookup by panel id.

nodes.name: DockReveal
nodes.summary: Service that surfaces a panel wherever it lives: activates expanded stacks, peeks collapsed ones, fronts floats, and focuses popped-out windows.

nodes.name: nearestEdge
nodes.summary: Finds the workspace edge nearest a pointer position within the edge threshold, or null when none is near.

nodes.name: guideLegality
nodes.summary: Determines which compass drop guides are legal for a candidate target stack given the dragged payload.

nodes.name: edgePreview
nodes.summary: Computes the preview rectangle shown when a drop would dock the payload against a workspace edge.

nodes.name: edgeGuideRect
nodes.summary: Computes the on-screen rectangle of an edge drop guide, inset from the workspace boundary.

nodes.name: resolveEdgeTarget
nodes.summary: Resolves a pointer near a workspace edge into an edge dock target with its preview rectangle.

nodes.name: resolveEdgeGuideTarget
nodes.summary: Resolves a pointer over an edge guide into its dock target, distinct from proximity-based edge resolution.

nodes.name: splitPreview
nodes.summary: Computes the preview rectangle for splitting a target stack on a given side.

nodes.name: resolveGroupTarget
nodes.summary: Resolves a pointer over a dock group into a center (tab-into) or side (split) target with legality applied.

nodes.name: resolveCompassTarget
nodes.summary: Resolves a pointer over the compass guide cluster into the specific guide target it hits, honouring guide legality.

nodes.name: mkStack
nodes.summary: Factory creating a stack node with panels, role, side, and a fresh or supplied node id.

nodes.name: mkSplit
nodes.summary: Factory creating a split node over child nodes along an axis with proportional sizes.

nodes.name: restoreLayout
nodes.summary: Rebuilds a dock layout tree from persisted storage: validates, sanitises against known panels, and reserves node ids; returns null when nothing usable survives.

nodes.name: isPersistedNode
nodes.summary: Structurally validates an untrusted persisted value as a plausible dock node, rejecting malformed or hand-edited storage.

nodes.name: sanitizeNode
nodes.summary: Recursively prunes a restored tree to panels the session still knows, collapsing degenerate splits left behind.

nodes.name: markdown-clipboard.ts
nodes.summary: Runs the markdown editor's clipboard and insertion commands against the live Milkdown pane: plaintext copy/cut, paste as markdown/plaintext/code, and parsed block/inline insertion via ProseMirror transactions.
nodes.languageNotes: Stateless by design — re-reads the pane through an accessor on every call so editor recreations after external content loads never leave a stale reference.

nodes.name: MarkdownClipboard
nodes.summary: Clipboard command runner reading navigator.clipboard itself (browsers block programmatic paste) and dispatching ProseMirror transactions for each paste/insert variant.

nodes.name: markdown-task-list.ts
nodes.summary: Implements the task-list toggle command: converts the selection's list items to or from GitHub-style task items via ProseMirror node attribute transactions, wrapping loose text in a bullet list first when needed.

nodes.name: collectListItems
nodes.summary: Collects the list-item nodes overlapping the current selection together with their document positions.

nodes.name: toggleTaskList
nodes.summary: Toggles checkbox state on the selection's list items, or wraps the selection in a bullet list and converts it when no list exists yet.

nodes.name: markdown-view.ts
nodes.summary: The markdown editor tab component: hosts the Milkdown editor with the GitHub-alert plugin, find panel, and side tool panels (Outline, Review, Agent, Reader), registers the ribbon command handler, keybindings, and an agent host, and publishes history and block-type state.
nodes.languageNotes: Angular standalone zoneless component; wires roughly a dozen collaborators (Reader, Review, panels registry, highlighters, agent host) around a single Milkdown pane.

nodes.name: MarkdownView
nodes.summary: Editor tab component coordinating editor lifecycle (onReady/content/selection), panel visibility from MarkdownPanels, agent conversation mounting, and command/keybinding registration per document.

nodes.name: outline-scroll-spy.ts
nodes.summary: Scroll-spy for the markdown outline: extracts headings from the ProseMirror document, tracks which heading last crossed the reading line while scrolling, and scrolls a chosen heading to that line on outline clicks.

nodes.name: OutlineScrollSpy
nodes.summary: Attaches to the editor's scroll viewport, refreshes the OutlineHeading list into MarkdownCommands, and keeps the active heading in sync outside the Angular zone.

nodes.name: markdown-outline-panel.ts
nodes.summary: Side tool panel rendering the document's heading outline as an indented list joined by an SVG connector path, with the active heading marked and click-to-navigate through MarkdownCommands.

nodes.name: buildConnectorPath
nodes.summary: Builds the SVG path string linking outline rows across heading levels, assuming uniform fixed-height rows.

nodes.name: MarkdownOutlinePanel
nodes.summary: Panel component computing outline rows and connector geometry from the shared outline signal, and delegating goTo clicks to MarkdownCommands.goToHeading.

nodes.name: markdown-review-panel.ts
nodes.summary: Side tool panel listing the active document's review issues with per-kind filter chips and per-issue actions: reveal in editor, apply suggestion, add to dictionary, and ignore.

nodes.name: MarkdownReviewPanel
nodes.summary: Panel component binding the Review service's issues, counts, and filter to the issue card list and forwarding user actions back to the service.

nodes.name: read-along-highlighter.ts
nodes.summary: Paints the read-along word and sentence highlights over the rendered editor using the CSS Custom Highlight API, keeping the spoken word visible by rebuilding the DOM read model and revealing the current range as the Reader progresses.

nodes.name: ReadAlongHighlighter
nodes.summary: Registers a ReadSession with the Reader, publishes the DOM-derived ReadModel, and maps the current spoken word to rendered ranges for word- or sentence-mode highlighting and auto-scroll.

nodes.name: review-reveal.ts
nodes.summary: Bridges review issues to the rendered editor: maps an issue's source range to rendered text positions, scrolls it into view, flashes a highlight over it, and applies suggestion edits back through the editor.

nodes.name: ReviewReveal
nodes.summary: Registers a ReviewSession with the Review service and implements reveal/apply: proportional source-to-rendered range resolution, centred scrolling, and a temporary CSS Custom Highlight flash.

nodes.name: github-alert-plugin.ts
nodes.summary: Milkdown plugin suite for GitHub-style alerts ([!NOTE], [!TIP], [!IMPORTANT], [!WARNING], [!CAUTION]): a remark transform, an alert block node schema rendered as styled icon boxes, five wrap-in-alert commands, and a prose plugin converting matching blockquotes.
nodes.languageNotes: Composed from Milkdown's $remark/$node/$command/$prose slices; the exported githubAlertPlugin bundles all pieces into one plugin array.

nodes.name: createWrapInAlertCommand
nodes.summary: Factory producing a Milkdown command that wraps the current block in an alert of the given type, backing the five exported wrap-in-*-alert commands.

nodes.name: findBlockquoteToConvert
nodes.summary: Scans the ProseMirror document for a blockquote whose first paragraph starts with an alert marker, returning the node and range for conversion into an alert block.

nodes.name: markdown-commands.ts
nodes.summary: Shared command hub service bridging the ribbon, menus, and panels to the active markdown editor's registered MarkdownCommandHandler: formatting, clipboard, history, insertion, block type, and outline/heading state.

nodes.name: MarkdownCommands
nodes.summary: Registry of per-view command handlers exposing the active editor's block type, history state, and outline as signals, and forwarding every ribbon command (bold, lists, tables, paste variants, etc.) to the active handler.

nodes.name: markdown-panels.ts
nodes.summary: Per-document registry service tracking which markdown editor tool panels (Outline, Review, Agent, Reader, Find) are open beside each editor tab, so switching tabs preserves each tab's own panel set.

nodes.name: MarkdownPanels
nodes.summary: Signal-based service exposing open/close/toggle/remove operations over a per-document set of open tool panels, with a stable empty-set reference to keep change detection quiet.

nodes.name: markdown-reader.ts
nodes.summary: Text-to-speech read-aloud service driving the browser SpeechSynthesis API with play/pause/seek/skip/rate/voice controls, word-boundary tracking, and per-session read-along highlight state.
nodes.languageNotes: Abstracts the platform SpeechSynthesis behind injectable factories (UtteranceFactory) so tests can run without the real speech API; voice loading handles the async voiceschanged race.

nodes.name: Reader
nodes.summary: Central reader service managing speech sessions per document: builds utterances, tracks the spoken word via boundary events, exposes progress/time signals, and resolves voices across engines.

nodes.name: read-model.ts
nodes.summary: Builds the ReadModel that maps rendered DOM text nodes to spoken word indices, letting the read-along highlighter locate each spoken word inside the live editor DOM.

nodes.name: readableBlock
nodes.summary: Resolves the nearest readable block ancestor for a DOM text node, filtering out non-prose containers so only spoken content is indexed.

nodes.name: buildReadModel
nodes.summary: Walks the rendered document root collecting words from text nodes into a model of word ranges with paragraph and sentence indices, aligned to the tokenized read document.

nodes.name: read-tokenize.ts
nodes.summary: Tokenizes a markdown or plain-text document into paragraphs, sentences, and words with document-global indices — the canonical structure the Reader speaks and the highlighter follows.

nodes.name: toParagraphs
nodes.summary: Splits raw document text into readable paragraphs, stripping markdown syntax (headings, fences, list markers, inline formatting) when reading markdown.

nodes.name: tokenizeDocument
nodes.summary: Top-level tokenizer producing a ReadDocument: paragraphs of words annotated with global word and sentence indices for playback and seeking.

nodes.name: reader-types.ts
nodes.summary: Type definitions for the read-aloud feature: HighlightMode, VoiceOption, and the ReadSession contract a view registers with the Reader service.

nodes.name: markdown-review.ts
nodes.summary: Document review service running debounced spelling/grammar/style analysis over the active markdown source, with filtering, apply-suggestion, ignore list, and a localStorage-backed personal dictionary.

nodes.name: Review
nodes.summary: Session-oriented review engine: registers per-document sessions, re-analyzes on source change after a 400ms debounce, and exposes issues, counts, and dictionary/ignore actions to the Review panel.

nodes.name: review-rules.ts
nodes.summary: Rule engine for the markdown review: masks non-prose markdown syntax, then finds spelling issues via the SpellChecker and grammar/style issues via rule regexes, producing context-clipped ReviewIssues.

nodes.name: maskText
nodes.summary: Blanks out markdown syntax (code, links, URLs, etc.) while preserving offsets, so rule matching only fires on prose.

nodes.name: makeIssue
nodes.summary: Constructs a ReviewIssue with a stable id and a clipped context excerpt either side of the flagged range.

nodes.name: findSpellingIssues
nodes.summary: Scans masked prose for words the SpellChecker rejects (respecting the user dictionary) and emits spelling issues with suggestions.

nodes.name: findRuleIssues
nodes.summary: Runs the grammar/style rule set over masked prose and emits an issue per regex match.

nodes.name: analyzeMarkdown
nodes.summary: Entry point combining masking, spelling, and rule passes into a single sorted issue list for a document.

nodes.name: review-spell.ts
nodes.summary: Lightweight spell checker: lazily loads an English word list and offers correctness checks plus suggestions ranked by a bounded Levenshtein edit distance.

nodes.name: loadEnglishWords
nodes.summary: Loads the bundled English dictionary word list for the spell checker.

nodes.name: boundedLevenshtein
nodes.summary: Computes edit distance between two words with an early-exit bound, keeping suggestion ranking cheap.

nodes.name: SpellChecker
nodes.summary: Wraps the dictionary set with isCorrect lookups and suggest, which returns up to three close-match corrections within edit distance two.

nodes.name: review-types.ts
nodes.summary: Type definitions for the review feature: ReviewKind categories, the ReviewIssue finding shape, per-kind ReviewCounts, and the ReviewSession contract.

nodes.name: build-command-handler.ts
nodes.summary: Factory that wires a MarkdownCommandHandler for the ribbon: routes formatting, history, table, clipboard, task-list, and outline commands to the live Milkdown editor and its collaborators.

nodes.name: buildMarkdownCommandHandler
nodes.summary: Builds the command handler object mapping each ribbon command to Milkdown preset commands, MarkdownClipboard operations, toggleTaskList, and OutlineScrollSpy navigation.

nodes.name: highlight-support.ts
nodes.summary: Tiny shared helpers for the highlight collaborators: constants for word scanning and reveal centring, plus detection of the CSS Custom Highlight API (absent under unit tests).

nodes.name: supportsHighlight
nodes.summary: Feature-detects the CSS Custom Highlight API so highlight painting degrades gracefully where it is unavailable.

nodes.name: agent-editor-capabilities.ts
nodes.summary: Registers the agent's in-editor tool capabilities with AiRuntime: reading, replacing, editing, and inserting into the active document, setting its language, running it in a persistent terminal with sentinel-based completion detection, and managing edit previews (preview, commit, cancel).
nodes.languageNotes: Delegates pure edit resolution and run-output parsing to sibling modules so the terminal- and DOM-free logic stays unit-testable.

nodes.name: AgentEditorCapabilities
nodes.summary: Capability provider wiring editor tools (read/replace/edit/insert active document, set language, run document, edit previews) into the AI runtime, with payload extraction and validation helpers.

nodes.name: document-edit.ts
nodes.summary: Pure helpers that resolve agent-requested document edits against source text: exact find/replace with not-found and ambiguity errors, and anchored insertion at a placement, returning new content or a descriptive failure.

nodes.name: resolveEdit
nodes.summary: Resolves a find/replace edit against document source, enforcing uniqueness of the old string unless replaceAll is set, and returning the new text or a structured not-found/ambiguous error.

nodes.name: resolveInsert
nodes.summary: Resolves an insertion of text into document source at a requested placement relative to an optional anchor string, returning the new text or a descriptive error.

nodes.name: run-output.ts
nodes.summary: Pure parser that isolates a program's output and exit code from a persistent run-terminal buffer using a printf sentinel, split out so the sentinel and exit-code logic can be unit-tested without a terminal.

nodes.name: parseRunOutput
nodes.summary: Parses a run's captured output and exit code from a terminal buffer by locating the echoed command and the trailing exit-status sentinel, trimming and capping output to the most recent maxLines.

nodes.name: agent-view.ts
nodes.summary: Top-level agent tab component hosting the AgentChat shell with the conversation history docked as a side panel; provides the per-tab Agent and AgentConversation, publishes the conversation to AgentSessions while active, and registers keybindings.

nodes.name: AgentView
nodes.summary: Standalone Angular component composing AgentChat and the conversation list inside a PanelLayout, binding the per-tab conversation context and cleaning up keybindings and session publication on destroy.

nodes.name: mission-control-agent-tile.ts
nodes.summary: Renders one Mission Control tile for a live agent host: an embedded agent chat with tool strip, run/stop controls, history toggle, hide toggle, a focus modal for full-size interaction, tab opening, and drag-to-resize.

nodes.name: MissionControlAgentTile
nodes.summary: Tile component binding a single agent host's conversation into a resizable Mission Control column, with focus-modal open/close, run/stop actions, and width persistence via the MissionControl state service.

nodes.name: mission-control-panel.ts
nodes.summary: Mission Control's side rail panel listing agent hosts with pulse-dot run status, per-host hide toggles, drag reordering, and click-to-reveal that scrolls the corresponding tile column into view.

nodes.name: MissionControlPanel
nodes.summary: Panel component rendering the agent host list rail, delegating reveal-on-click to MissionControlTiles and visibility/ordering state to the MissionControl service.

nodes.name: mission-control-tiles.ts
nodes.summary: View-scoped registry mapping each live agent host id to its rendered tile element so the rail can scroll a column into view; honours the missionControl.tileScrollMode setting (minimal into-view versus absolute-left with a grown trailing spacer).
nodes.languageNotes: Provided at the MissionControlView injector level so element references are tied to one Mission Control instance and garbage-collected with it.

nodes.name: MissionControlTiles
nodes.summary: Injectable registry of tile elements, the scrolling row, and its trailing spacer, exposing reveal-scrolling in two modes and spacer sizing driven by the tile scroll-mode setting.

nodes.name: mission-control-view.ts
nodes.summary: The Mission Control view component composing the side panel rail with a horizontally scrolling row of agent tiles, creating a per-tile child injector for each host and tearing rows down when hosts disappear.

nodes.name: MissionControlView
nodes.summary: View component that materialises one MissionControlAgentTile per visible agent host via dynamically created injectors, providing MissionControlTiles at its own level and applying the MissionControl visibility filters.

nodes.name: mission-control.ts
nodes.summary: Root singleton holding Mission Control's shared view state: per-tile width overrides set by dragging, run-state visibility filters (hide empty/idle/working), and per-host hidden flags, shared between the view, tiles, and the contextual ribbon.
nodes.languageNotes: A root singleton because Mission Control is a singleton tab whose ribbon is mounted by the shell in a different injector branch and must share the same instance.

nodes.name: MissionControl
nodes.summary: Signal-backed state service exposing tile width get/set/reset, run-state filter setters, and per-host hidden toggles for the Mission Control feature.

nodes.name: agent-terminal-capabilities.ts
nodes.summary: Registers the agent's terminal tool capabilities with AiRuntime: reading a terminal session's output text and writing input to a terminal over the terminal bridge, with payload validation and capped reads.

nodes.name: AgentTerminalCapabilities
nodes.summary: Capability provider wiring read-terminal-output and write-terminal-input tools into the AI runtime, resolving terminal sessions via Terminals and the terminal bridge.

nodes.name: terminal-agent-panel.ts
nodes.summary: Docked agent conversation panel inside the terminal view, hosting a terminal-scoped agent conversation in an agent-conversation-panel with close handling.

nodes.name: TerminalAgentPanel
nodes.summary: Thin panel component providing the terminal-scoped Agent and AgentConversation and delegating rendering to the shared agent conversation panel.

nodes.name: agent-run-configuration-capabilities.ts
nodes.summary: Registers the agent's run-configuration tool capabilities with AiRuntime: listing, saving, and deleting the active workspace's run configurations, validating agent-supplied payloads before persisting through the studio config.

nodes.name: AgentRunConfigurationCapabilities
nodes.summary: Capability provider exposing list/save/delete run-configuration tools to the AI runtime, with array payload validation against the active workspace's configuration store.

nodes.name: run-configuration-agent.ts
nodes.summary: Service that dispatches run-configuration authoring work to a background agent host: the Auto button's self-contained workspace-assessment prompt or a user-supplied request, surfacing progress through AgentRequests and opening the resulting tab.

nodes.name: RunConfigurationAgent
nodes.summary: Service exposing dispatchAuto and dispatchRequest, both funnelling into a shared dispatch that targets an agent host scoped to the active workspace and tracks the request lifecycle.

nodes.name: agent-chat.ts
nodes.summary: The shared agent chat transcript component: renders streaming assistant text, thinking, tool-call summaries, permission and input prompts, edit decisions, payload reveal, images, retry/copy actions, and visibility-gated auto-scroll with a show-earlier window.
nodes.languageNotes: Auto-scroll arithmetic is deliberately guarded: scrollHeight under-reports under content-visibility, so tail-following is driven by observers rather than raw measurements.

nodes.name: buildPayloadView
nodes.summary: Builds the view model for a collapsible tool payload section, pairing the transcript item and section with its text and revealed state.

nodes.name: AgentChat
nodes.summary: Large standalone component managing the transcript render loop: scroll and tail watching, message windowing, permission/input/edit-decision responses, retries with diagnostics, and clipboard copy.

nodes.name: tool-summary.ts
nodes.summary: Maps provider tool names (with MCP prefixes stripped) to short human-friendly labels for the chat transcript, covering built-in Claude Code tools and Studio's in-app capabilities with a generic fallback.

nodes.name: friendlyToolLabel
nodes.summary: Returns the human-friendly description for a tool name, falling back to a generic 'Performed an action' label when unmapped.

nodes.name: technicalToolName
nodes.summary: Returns the technical tool name to show alongside the friendly label when the user expands a tool call.

nodes.name: agent-composer.ts
nodes.summary: The agent input composer component: multiline prompt entry with slash-command, file, and effort suggestions, image attachment via paste/drag/drop, a prompt library, queued-message editing, history recall, a markdown editor modal, quick responses, and the in-app Claude login flow.

nodes.name: AgentComposer
nodes.summary: Large standalone component coordinating composer input state: suggestion filtering and acceptance, slash-command execution, prompt save/delete, image encoding to base64, keyboard navigation, and send/stop against the bound conversation.

nodes.name: agent-tool-strip.ts
nodes.summary: Compact strip of agent controls shown above the composer: conversation history toggle, engine (provider and model) selection via dropdown, and the remote-control toggle with its confirmation modal.

nodes.name: AgentToolStrip
nodes.summary: Standalone component surfacing history, engine, and remote-control actions, delegating state changes to the bound AgentConversation and agent-engine services.

nodes.name: radio.ts
nodes.summary: Themed radio control atom backed by a native radio input for accessibility; renders only the dial, with callers supplying label markup and driving selection within a group.

nodes.name: Radio
nodes.summary: Minimal form atom exposing checked as a model signal plus disabled and name inputs, relaying native change events.

nodes.name: pulse-dot.ts
nodes.summary: The app's single shared status dot component: a small solid round indicator coloured by a semantic tone (neutral, accent, success, warning, danger, info) that optionally pulses its opacity without affecting layout.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately ring-free so pulsing never shifts layout; used everywhere a status dot appears (Icon.SPINNER does not spin, so pulse-dot is the working indicator).

nodes.name: PulseDot
nodes.summary: Template-less component driving tone, size, and pulse entirely through host bindings and computed CSS classes.

nodes.name: agent-conversation.ts
nodes.summary: Per-context agent conversation service coordinating the chat lifecycle: new chat, stop, history toggle, mode/provider/model and remote-control selection, context attachments (file, folder, selection), compaction, open/delete/rename/duplicate of persisted conversations, and debounced persistence.

nodes.name: AgentConversation
nodes.summary: Injectable binding an AgentConversationContext to the Agent runtime and the persisted conversation store, deriving titles, preserving branch origins on duplicate, and scheduling saves through a debounce.

nodes.name: markdown-math-modal.ts
nodes.summary: Insert modal collecting a LaTeX expression for an inline or block math element, emitting the confirmed expression back to the markdown ribbon.

nodes.name: MarkdownMathModal
nodes.summary: Form modal built on FormModal with confirm/cancel/reset handling for the math expression fields.

nodes.name: markdown-ribbon.ts
nodes.summary: The markdown editor's full ribbon: file actions (save/print/export-PDF), clipboard, undo/redo, find/outline/review/reader/agent panel toggles, and the Insert group (formatting marks, lists, tables, images, links, math, diagrams, footnotes, collapse sections, emoji) backed by dedicated insert modals.
nodes.languageNotes: Hosts six insert modals (image, link, math, footnote, collapse, emoji) whose submissions it turns into markdown insertions via MarkdownCommands.

nodes.name: MarkdownRibbon
nodes.summary: Large Angular ribbon component forwarding editing actions through MarkdownCommands and Documents, opening the insert modals and handling their submissions, and contributing its actions to the feature app menu.

nodes.name: mission-control-ribbon.ts
nodes.summary: Ribbon strip for Mission Control: stop-all agents, the Remote Control toggle with its confirmation modal, reset layout, hide-empty/idle/working filters, and the default agent posture picker.

nodes.name: MissionControlRibbon
nodes.summary: Angular ribbon component coordinating AgentHosts and Settings for fleet-wide agent controls and persisting Mission Control view filters.

nodes.name: model-manager-ribbon.ts
nodes.summary: Ribbon strip for the AI Model Manager with refresh, start, and stop actions forwarded through the ModelManagerCommands registry.

nodes.name: ModelManagerRibbon
nodes.summary: Angular ribbon component forwarding model lifecycle actions to ModelManagerCommands and contributing them to the feature app menu.

nodes.name: plugin-manager-ribbon.ts
nodes.summary: Minimal ribbon strip for the Plugin Manager with a refresh action that reloads the plugin registry via the Plugins service.

nodes.name: PluginManagerRibbon
nodes.summary: Angular ribbon component exposing a single refresh action and contributing it to the feature app menu.

nodes.name: metric-tile.ts
nodes.summary: Presentational metric tile for the System Monitor's top grid: a labelled header over one or more sparklines, with optional per-app overlay readings splitting SYS/APP values.

nodes.name: MetricTile
nodes.summary: OnPush component rendering single-channel (CPU/GPU/Memory) or multi-channel (Network/Disk) tiles; consumers supply formatted readings and numeric series.

nodes.name: system-monitor-metrics.ts
nodes.summary: Renderer-side client for the System Monitor metrics backend: a thin typed wrapper over the IPC Bridge with ref-counted start/stop sampling and an onSample subscription; every method is a safe no-op outside Electron.

nodes.name: SystemMonitorMetrics
nodes.summary: @Service wrapping Bridge send/subscribe on the SystemMonitorChannel so views start sampling on show and stop on hide.

nodes.name: sparkline.ts
nodes.summary: Minimal dependency-free sparkline component: a signal-driven SVG line with a faint filled area, plotting values oldest-to-newest scaled to a max, with a non-scaling stroke for crispness at any size.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses preserveAspectRatio=none with a fixed 100x100 viewBox and vector-effect non-scaling-stroke, following the CommitGraph SVG-from-signals pattern.

nodes.name: Sparkline
nodes.summary: OnPush component computing SVG polyline and area path strings from an input series via toLine/toArea.

nodes.name: system-monitor-commands.ts
nodes.summary: Command registry decoupling the System Monitor ribbon from the active view: the view registers a SystemMonitorCommandHandler while active, and refresh/clearFilters/copy forward through it, no-oping when no view is active.

nodes.name: SystemMonitorCommands
nodes.summary: @Service registry holding the active handler in a signal, exposing hasRecords derived state and forwarding methods for the ribbon.

nodes.name: system-monitor-ribbon.ts
nodes.summary: Ribbon strip for the System Monitor with refresh, clear-filters, and copy actions forwarded through the SystemMonitorCommands registry.

nodes.name: SystemMonitorRibbon
nodes.summary: Angular ribbon component forwarding audit-view actions to SystemMonitorCommands and contributing them to the feature app menu.

nodes.name: agent-ribbon.ts
nodes.summary: Ribbon strip for the AI Agent view offering new chat, stop, history, compact, context attachment (file/folder/selection), engine selection, and the Remote Control toggle with its confirmation modal.

nodes.name: AgentRibbon
nodes.summary: Angular component driving the agent session via AgentEngine and AgentSessions services; contributes its actions to the feature app menu and forwards mode/engine changes.

nodes.name: api-explorer-commands.ts
nodes.summary: Command registry decoupling the API Explorer ribbon from the active view: the view registers an ApiExplorerCommandHandler while active, and the ribbon's forwarding methods (send, save, new request/collection/environment, cycle environment) no-op when no tab is active.

nodes.name: ApiExplorerCommands
nodes.summary: @Service registry holding the active view's handler in a signal and exposing derived state (canSend, sending, environmentName, documentDirty) plus forwarding methods for the ribbon.

nodes.name: api-explorer-ribbon.ts
nodes.summary: Ribbon strip for the API Explorer view with Save/Save As, Send, and New Request/Collection/Environment actions, all forwarded through the ApiExplorerCommands registry.

nodes.name: ApiExplorerRibbon
nodes.summary: Angular ribbon component reading derived state from ApiExplorerCommands and contributing its actions to the feature app menu.

nodes.name: binary-ribbon.ts
nodes.summary: Ribbon strip for the binary (hex) editor: save, undo/redo, insert-mode toggle, disassembly/inspector/agent panel toggles, go-to navigation, row width, and clipboard copy/cut with format variants.

nodes.name: BinaryRibbon
nodes.summary: Angular ribbon component driving the active BinaryDocument and BinaryPanels, with clipboard formatting helpers and feature-menu contribution.

nodes.name: code-ribbon.ts
nodes.summary: Ribbon strip for the code editor: save/print/export-PDF, format, clipboard, undo/redo, find, language picker, run, terminal, agent toggle, and word-wrap/minimap/line-number view toggles.

nodes.name: CodeRibbon
nodes.summary: Angular ribbon component wiring EditorCommands, Documents, Monaco, Printing, Settings, CodeRunner, and EditorTerminals into the code editor's toolbar, and contributing its actions to the feature app menu.

nodes.name: containers-ribbon.ts
nodes.summary: Ribbon strip for the Containers view with start, stop, remove, logs, shell, and refresh actions forwarded through the ContainersCommands registry.

nodes.name: ContainersRibbon
nodes.summary: Angular ribbon component forwarding container lifecycle actions to ContainersCommands and contributing them to the feature app menu.

nodes.name: form-modal.ts
nodes.summary: Shared chrome for the markdown Insert group's field modals: wraps the reusable Modal with heading, projected field content, and Cancel/primary action buttons so each insert modal supplies only its fields and validity.

nodes.name: FormModal
nodes.summary: Presentational wrapper component declaring the modal's content template so callers' projected fields render inside the modal's own window.

nodes.name: markdown-collapse-modal.ts
nodes.summary: Insert modal collecting a summary label for a collapsible <details> block, emitting the confirmed value back to the markdown ribbon.

nodes.name: MarkdownCollapseModal
nodes.summary: Form modal built on FormModal with confirm/cancel/reset handling for the collapse-section fields.

nodes.name: markdown-footnote-modal.ts
nodes.summary: Insert modal collecting a footnote label and text, emitting the confirmed footnote back to the markdown ribbon.

nodes.name: MarkdownFootnoteModal
nodes.summary: Form modal built on FormModal with confirm/cancel/reset handling for the footnote fields.

nodes.name: markdown-link-modal.ts
nodes.summary: Insert modal collecting link text and URL, emitting the confirmed hyperlink back to the markdown ribbon.

nodes.name: MarkdownLinkModal
nodes.summary: Form modal built on FormModal with confirm/cancel/reset handling for the link fields.

nodes.name: system-monitor-view.ts
nodes.summary: Task-Manager-style System Monitor tool view combining live metric tiles (CPU, memory, network, disk, GPU sparkline histories) with a per-session log audit table featuring severity, session, and text filters.
nodes.languageNotes: Zoneless Angular signals throughout: metric histories are signals updated per sample, filters are computed signals, and an effect starts/stops sampling as the tab becomes active or hidden.

nodes.name: SystemMonitorView
nodes.summary: Angular component that renders metric tiles fed by SystemMonitorMetrics samples and a filterable, selectable log-record table backed by the Log service, with copy-to-clipboard, session switching, and ribbon command registration tied to tab activity.

nodes.name: system-monitor.feature.ts
nodes.summary: Feature descriptor contributing the System Monitor as a singleton tool view with its contextual ribbon through the lazy featureContributions seam, so it ships in its own code-split chunk.

nodes.name: terminal-ribbon.ts
nodes.summary: Contextual ribbon for terminal tabs offering session, clipboard, navigation, scroll, find, and agent-toggle actions, delegating every button to TerminalCommands and contributing the terminal section of the application menu.

nodes.name: TerminalRibbon
nodes.summary: Ribbon component whose handlers (onNew, onClear, onCopy, onFind, onAgent, etc.) forward to TerminalCommands and TerminalAgents, with menu-button item lists for shell selection and clear variants built from TerminalShells.

nodes.name: ribbon-host.ts
nodes.summary: Host directive applying the shared flex layout every per-tab-type ribbon needs, via host style bindings instead of a stylesheet because relocated components cannot resolve path aliases in styleUrl.
nodes.languageNotes: Used through Angular hostDirectives composition so the identical layout block no longer has to be copied into each feature ribbon's own SCSS.

nodes.name: RibbonHost
nodes.summary: Attribute directive that sets display:flex, flex:1, stretch alignment, and min-inline-size:0 on the hosting ribbon so its overflow wrapper can lay groups out in a row.

nodes.name: ribbon-strip-button-small.ts
nodes.summary: Small ribbon button atom rendering an icon with optional label, tooltip, toggle/pressed state, and icon rotation, emitting an action event on click.

nodes.name: RibbonStripButtonSmall
nodes.summary: Compact ribbon button component with signal inputs for icon, label, disabled, tooltip, iconOnly, and toggle/pressed state; onClick emits the action output.

nodes.name: ribbon-strip-button.ts
nodes.summary: Large ribbon button atom wrapping the shared Button component with icon, label, tone, toggle state, and tooltip support for primary ribbon actions.

nodes.name: RibbonStripButton
nodes.summary: Primary ribbon button component with inputs for icon, label, disabled, iconRotation, tone, iconOnly, and toggle/pressed state; onClick emits the action output.

nodes.name: ribbon-strip-check.ts
nodes.summary: Ribbon checkbox atom wrapping the shared Checkbox component with label, checked, and disabled inputs, re-emitting toggle events for ribbon settings.

nodes.name: RibbonStripCheck
nodes.summary: Thin checkbox wrapper component exposing label, checked, and disabled inputs and a toggled output for use inside ribbon groups.

nodes.name: ribbon-strip-column.ts
nodes.summary: Layout component stacking small ribbon controls vertically within a group, with an optional spread mode to distribute them.

nodes.name: RibbonStripColumn
nodes.summary: Vertical stacking container for ribbon controls, exposing a spread input that switches distribution of the projected children.

nodes.name: ribbon-strip-field.ts
nodes.summary: Labelled dropdown field atom for ribbons, mapping option inputs to the shared Dropdown component and emitting the changed value.

nodes.name: RibbonStripField
nodes.summary: Ribbon dropdown field component with label, options, value, disabled, and fullWidth inputs; computed signals adapt its options and selection for the shared Dropdown.

nodes.name: ribbon-strip-group.ts
nodes.summary: Titled grouping container that clusters related ribbon controls under a caption, the unit the overflow component moves into its flyout.

nodes.name: RibbonStripGroup
nodes.summary: Container component with a title input rendering a captioned group of projected ribbon controls.

nodes.name: ribbon-strip-menu-button.ts
nodes.summary: Split ribbon button with an attached dropdown menu: the main face emits a default action while the chevron opens a CDK menu of items and emits the chosen item's id.

nodes.name: RibbonStripMenuButton
nodes.summary: Menu-button component taking icon, label, tooltip, menuName, items, and tone inputs; onAction emits the primary action and onSelect emits the selected menu item identifier.

nodes.name: ribbon-strip-overflow.ts
nodes.summary: Responsive overflow wrapper for ribbon rows: a ResizeObserver-driven reflow moves whole groups that no longer fit into a 'More' flyout, restoring them when space returns, with pointer-down and Escape dismissal.
nodes.languageNotes: Reflows by physically re-parenting group DOM nodes between the row and the flyout with insertBefore, scheduled through requestAnimationFrame to coalesce resize bursts.

nodes.name: RibbonStripOverflow
nodes.summary: Overflow controller component measuring the ribbon row against available width, moving trailing groups into a flyout on overflow, tracking overflowCount and flyoutOpen signals, and honouring a settings-driven alignment.

nodes.name: ribbon-strip-row.ts
nodes.summary: Minimal horizontal row container laying ribbon groups out side by side inside the overflow wrapper.

nodes.name: RibbonStripRow
nodes.summary: Content-projection component rendering a horizontal flex row of ribbon groups.

nodes.name: app-menu-model.ts
nodes.summary: Renderer-side authoring model for application menu entries: the wire shape plus the run handler that never crosses IPC, along with the MENU_SEPARATOR constant.

nodes.name: app-menu.ts
nodes.summary: Application menu service composing owner contributions into menu sections, publishing the handler-stripped wire model to the main process over the bridge, and dispatching chosen command ids back to registered handlers.
nodes.languageNotes: A signal effect republishes the composed menu whenever contributions change; accelerator de-duplication drops base entries whose shortcuts an incoming contribution claims, and separators are tidied recursively.

nodes.name: AppMenu
nodes.summary: Injectable service where features contribute() menu sections under an owner id; it merges contributions, strips handlers to the wire model, sends it via MenuChannel.SetMenu, and routes MenuChannel.Command ids back to entry.run, deferring native roles through runRole.

nodes.name: contribute-feature-menu.ts
nodes.summary: Helper that wires a feature's reactive menu sections into AppMenu inside an effect and clears the owner's contribution on destroy.

nodes.name: contributeFeatureMenu
nodes.summary: Injects AppMenu and DestroyRef, contributes the provided sections under an owner id in a reactive effect, and unregisters the owner when the injector is destroyed.

nodes.name: menu-channels.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the application-menu IPC channel names (set, command, run-role) and the MenuClient interface the renderer uses to publish menus and receive chosen commands from the main process.

nodes.name: menu-types.ts
nodes.summary: Wire model for the application menu shared by renderer and main process: AppMenuItem, AppMenuSection, and item kinds as pure data carrying command ids rather than callbacks so it can cross IPC.

nodes.name: system-monitor-channels.ts
nodes.summary: Names the System Monitor's ref-counted start/stop/sample IPC channels and defines the MetricsSample payload contracts (CPU, memory, network, disk, GPU) plus the METRICS_HISTORY sparkline depth.

nodes.name: agent-conversation-context.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the injection tokens through which an IDE view supplies an agent host's conversation context and declared agent kind, plus the global fallback context for standalone agent tabs.
nodes.languageNotes: Angular InjectionToken pattern: hosts provide resolvers read at call time so context tracks live workspace/repository state.

nodes.name: agentTypeFromContextKind
nodes.summary: Derives a display agent type (Workspace, Review, etc.) from a conversation context kind when a host declares no explicit AGENT_CONVERSATION_KIND.

nodes.name: agent-engine.ts
nodes.summary: Owns the global engine selection shared by every agent conversation: the registered AI providers loaded from the runtime and the user's persisted connection/model choice that the ribbon, tool strip, and each Agent session all read.

nodes.name: AgentEngine
nodes.summary: Singleton service holding the provider list and the app-wide provider/model selection, persisted through Settings and reloaded when the user's connections change.

nodes.name: engine-options.ts
nodes.summary: Pure helpers that encode provider/model pairs as dropdown option values for the engine picker, build the grouped option list from providers, and parse or apply a selected value back onto a target.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a '::' separator that connection ids can never contain, so provider-authored model ids with punctuation survive round-tripping.

nodes.name: engineOptionValue
nodes.summary: Encodes a provider id and model id into a single dropdown option value using the '::' separator.

nodes.name: engineOptions
nodes.summary: Builds the grouped dropdown option list from the registered providers, adding a placeholder row for a connection that offers no models.

nodes.name: parseEngineOption
nodes.summary: Splits an engine option value back into its provider id and model id at the first '::' occurrence.

nodes.name: applyEngineOption
nodes.summary: Parses a selected engine option value and applies the provider/model pair onto a selection target, validating against the known providers.

nodes.name: agent-host-registration.ts
nodes.summary: Provides a deferred agent-host registrar: created in an injection context, it registers a tab's live agent with the app-wide AgentHosts and AgentRequests registries once the owning tab id is known, so the agent appears in Mission Control and the requests inbox for the tab's whole lifetime.

nodes.name: createAgentHostRegistrar
nodes.summary: Factory that captures injected registries and returns a registrar completing the tab's host and request registration (with cleanup) once the tab id is available.

nodes.name: agent-hosts.ts
nodes.summary: App-wide registry of live agent hosts: each tab-hosted agent registers here so surfaces like Mission Control can enumerate running agents, reorder them, toggle remote control for all, and stop everything at once. Also defines the AGENT_HOST token and HostRunLauncher capability interface.

nodes.name: AgentHosts
nodes.summary: Singleton registry tracking registered agent hosts in display order, with computed running/remote-capable views and bulk stop and remote-control operations.

nodes.name: agent-perf.ts
nodes.summary: Opt-in instrumentation for agent transcript performance: aggregates row rebuilds, stream flushes, keystrokes, and browser long tasks into one summarised log record per second, so sluggishness in the chat can be audited without flooding the log.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses PerformanceObserver longtask entries (>50ms) to correlate UI jank with transcript activity.

nodes.name: AgentPerf
nodes.summary: Singleton collector that counts transcript rebuilds, flushes, and keystrokes, observes main-thread long tasks, and periodically summarises the counters into the log when enabled.

nodes.name: agent-requests.ts
nodes.summary: App-wide registry of pending agent requests (permission prompts, input questions, edit decisions) across every registered conversation, attributing each to its hosting tab so the requests inbox, toasts, and tab-attention badges can surface them.

nodes.name: AgentRequests
nodes.summary: Singleton registry over registered conversation sources exposing a computed list of pending request entries, their count, the tabs involved, and a per-tab pending check.

nodes.name: agent-sessions.ts
nodes.summary: Bridges the agent ribbon to whichever conversation is active: defines the AgentSessionHandle slice a host provides and a singleton that forwards ribbon commands (new chat, stop, mode, provider/model, context attach, compact) to the active session's handle.

nodes.name: AgentSessions
nodes.summary: Singleton holding the active AgentSessionHandle and exposing computed session state plus command methods the agent ribbon invokes, each delegating to the active conversation or no-oping when none is active.

nodes.name: agent-tasks.ts
nodes.summary: App-wide registry of live background agent tasks across conversations, pairing each task with its owning conversation so the status strip's tasks menu can list them, reveal the owning tab, or stop a task.

nodes.name: AgentTasks
nodes.summary: Singleton aggregating each registered owner's tasks into a flat live list with count, plus reveal and stop operations that route back to the owning conversation.

nodes.name: agent-workspace-root.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the AGENT_WORKSPACE_ROOT injection token a host provides to override the working directory an agent run acts within — e.g. the repository tab supplies its git root instead of the global workspace root.

nodes.name: agent.ts
nodes.summary: The per-conversation agent session service: owns the transcript, streams model events into it, dispatches sends and queued turns, manages runs, modes, context attachments, permission/input/edit prompts, background tasks, login prompting, and token/cost accounting. Provided per AgentChat so every tab and dock panel gets its own transcript.
nodes.languageNotes: Provided with autoProvided:false at the AgentChat component level — deliberately not a singleton; global engine selection comes from AgentEngine.

nodes.name: Agent
nodes.summary: Per-conversation session engine (~60 methods) covering the full turn lifecycle: send/queue/rewind, run start and stop, streamed text flushing, tool and permission events, background task adoption, auth-failure login prompting, compaction, and transcript mutation.

nodes.name: auth-failure.ts
nodes.summary: Recognises a Claude sign-in failure from a run's error or reply text via known CLI/SDK wording signatures, giving the renderer a fast IPC-free path to raise the login modal before the authoritative auth check.

nodes.name: looksLikeAuthFailure
nodes.summary: Tests whether an error detail contains any known Claude authentication-failure signature substring.

nodes.name: isNotLoggedInReply
nodes.summary: Tests whether a model reply's text is the CLI's 'not logged in' response.

nodes.name: token-format.ts
nodes.summary: Pure formatting helpers for the agent's token and cost readouts (compact k/M token counts, dollar costs), kept separate from components for isolated unit testing.

nodes.name: formatTokens
nodes.summary: Formats a token count compactly: plain below a thousand, one-decimal 'k' up to a million, 'M' above; invalid inputs render as '0'.

nodes.name: formatCost
nodes.summary: Formats a USD cost for the readout with sensible precision for small and large amounts.

nodes.name: ai-connections.ts
nodes.summary: Manages the user's AI provider connections in the renderer: the persisted connection collection, per-connection credential state and key management routed through the main process (the key never enters the renderer), model discovery, and per-model curation (pin, hide, default, map).

nodes.name: AiConnections
nodes.summary: Singleton CRUD-and-curation service over the AiConnection collection with auth-status refresh, key set/clear via the bridge, model discovery, ordering, and default restoration.

nodes.name: ai-runtime.ts
nodes.summary: Renderer-side runtime for the agent: the single streamed-event subscription, the run/abort/steer/stop-task surface, Claude auth and login flow calls, and the registry answering the main process's in-app capability requests. Degrades to safe no-ops outside Electron.

nodes.name: AiRuntime
nodes.summary: Singleton wrapping the Ai bridge client: multiplexes streamed AiEvents to per-run listeners, exposes run control and Claude login operations, and dispatches in-app capability bridge requests to registered handlers.

nodes.name: ai.ts
nodes.summary: Thin renderer client for the AI-agent IPC capability: assembles a typed AiClient that forwards each operation to its AiChannel over the generic window.bridge transport, undefined outside Electron so agent services no-op safely.

nodes.name: createClient
nodes.summary: Builds the AiClient by mapping each typed operation onto bridge.invoke, bridge.on, or bridge.send against its AiChannel.

nodes.name: Ai
nodes.summary: Singleton exposing the assembled AiClient (or undefined outside Electron) as its sole member.

nodes.name: terminals.ts
nodes.summary: Registry of live terminal views by id: a terminal registers a lightweight handle so agent capabilities can read its on-screen buffer as text without holding the view itself.

nodes.name: Terminals
nodes.summary: Singleton mapping terminal ids to registered handles with register, unregister, and readText operations.

nodes.name: ai-channels.ts
nodes.summary: The AI-agent capability's slice of the IPC contract: the AiChannel enum naming every invoke/on/send channel and the typed AiClient interface both the renderer's Ai client and the main-process AiManager implement, deliberately excluding the API key from the surface.
nodes.languageNotes: Auth/config/run-control are request/response invoke channels; event and capability streams are main-to-renderer subscriptions; replies are fire-and-forget sends.

nodes.name: ai-types.ts
nodes.summary: Platform-neutral barrel re-exporting the shared AI-agent contract (provider, connection, run, event, and reply types plus seed constants) from the per-concern modules under ./ai/, giving both the Electron and Angular compilation targets one stable import path.

nodes.name: model-connections.ts
nodes.summary: Service that keeps AI connection entries in sync with the local Ollama runtime, linking newly installed models into matching local connections and unlinking removed ones.

nodes.name: model-manager-commands.ts
nodes.summary: Command seam exposing the Model Manager view's refresh/start/stop actions and running/stoppable/busy state signals so the ribbon can drive the active view without a direct reference.

nodes.name: model-manager-view.ts
nodes.summary: The AI Model Manager tool view component: shows the local runtime's status and installed/running models, drives runtime install/start/stop, and searches the model catalogue to pull, monitor, and remove local models.
nodes.languageNotes: Zoneless Angular component built on signals; subscribes to bridge progress events in the constructor and tears them down via DestroyRef.

nodes.name: model-manager.feature.ts
nodes.summary: Feature descriptor contributing the Model Manager singleton tool view and its contextual ribbon to the application shell through the lazy featureContributions seam.
nodes.languageNotes: Registered via the code-split featureContributions seam so the shell never compiles against the feature directly.

nodes.name: model-runtimes.ts
nodes.summary: Renderer-side facade over the model-runtime IPC bridge: install/start/stop the local runtime, list/pull/remove models, search the catalogue, and subscribe to install, pull, and status progress events.

nodes.name: ai-auth-types.ts
nodes.summary: Shared types for AI connection authentication: auth requests, API-key set requests, and the AiAuthStatus/AiAuthSource shapes reported per connection.

nodes.name: ai-connection-types.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the core AiConnection record plus the AiProviderKind and AiAuthKind unions — the unit of AI provider configuration shared between main and renderer.

nodes.name: ai-discovery-types.ts
nodes.summary: Request/result types for discovering the models available on an AI connection (AiDiscoverModelsRequest and AiDiscoverModelsResult).

nodes.name: ai-provider-catalog.ts
nodes.summary: Presentation catalogue for AI providers: company labels, per-company settings pages with their add-configuration methods, and helpers that resolve a connection's page and display label.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure platform-neutral data (no Electron or Angular dependency) so both the settings feature and the shared agent picker can import it.

nodes.name: ai-provider-types.ts
nodes.summary: Shared AI provider primitives: effort levels, Claude executable choice, remote-control modes/postures, and the AiModelInfo/AiProviderInfo shapes, with their canonical constant lists.

nodes.name: ai-run-types.ts
nodes.summary: Types describing an AI agent run request: permission posture, tool policy, agent mode, context/image attachments, and the AiRunRequest envelope sent from renderer to main.

nodes.name: ai-seed-connections.ts
nodes.summary: The default AI connections (Claude, Codex, Anthropic API key, Ollama) seeded on fresh install and used as the migration target for legacy provider settings, including their bundled model lists.
nodes.languageNotes: Connection ids intentionally match the legacy provider ids so per-provider model choices migrate one-to-one.

nodes.name: ai-tool-policy.ts
nodes.summary: Declares the catalogue of gateable agent tools (GATEABLE_TOOLS) and the default per-tool policy ('ask') used by the agent permission system.

nodes.name: ai-tool-surface.ts
nodes.summary: Platform-neutral constants naming every in-app capability the AI agent can invoke — document editing, terminal, binary editor, run configurations, API explorer, and file operations.
nodes.languageNotes: Kept free of Node and DOM dependencies so both the Electron main and Angular renderer compilation targets can import it.

nodes.name: model-catalog-types.ts
nodes.summary: Types for the downloadable model catalogue: CatalogModel entries from curated or HuggingFace sources, plus the CatalogQuery/CatalogResult search contract.

nodes.name: model-runtime-channels.ts
nodes.summary: Enumerates the IPC channel names (ModelRuntimeChannel) used between the renderer and the main-process model runtime engine.

nodes.name: model-runtime-types.ts
nodes.summary: Shared types for the local model runtime: local/running model records, runtime info and status, installation state and progress, model pull progress, and disk usage.

nodes.name: ModelConnections
nodes.summary: Links installed local models into matching Ollama connections and unlinks removed ones, keeping the AI connections store consistent with the runtime's model list.

nodes.name: ModelManagerCommands
nodes.summary: Holds the active view's command handler and forwards refresh/start/stop invocations to it, exposing running/stoppable/busy signals for ribbon state.

nodes.name: ModelManagerView
nodes.summary: The Model Manager view component: renders installed/running/available model tables, orchestrates runtime install/start/stop, catalogue search, model pulls with progress, and removal.

nodes.name: ModelRuntimes
nodes.summary: Wraps every model-runtime IPC channel in a typed async method, resolving to safe defaults when the bridge is absent and relaying pull/install/status progress events to listeners.

nodes.name: providerPageForKind
nodes.summary: Finds the provider settings page whose kinds include the given AiProviderKind.

nodes.name: providerDisplayLabel
nodes.summary: Builds the 'Company (Display Name)' label used for a connection in the agent provider picker.

nodes.name: binary.e2e.ts
nodes.summary: Playwright E2E suite verifying that a recently opened ELF executable reopens disassembled in the binary editor, using a hand-built minimal x86-64 ELF fixture and a Monaco-model probe to read the disassembly listing.
nodes.languageNotes: Constructs a byte-accurate 64-byte ELF header plus PT_LOAD program header in a Node Buffer so the disassembler has real instructions at a known offset.

nodes.name: buildElfFixture
nodes.summary: Builds a minimal but well-formed x86-64 ELF executable buffer with one PT_LOAD segment and six bytes of real machine code at the entry point, for use as an on-disk test fixture.

nodes.name: readDisasmListing
nodes.summary: Evaluates in the renderer to scan Monaco editor models for a disassembly-style listing (hex-address-prefixed lines) and returns its text for assertion.

nodes.name: editor.e2e.ts
nodes.summary: Playwright E2E suite covering editing flows: typing into the Milkdown/ProseMirror markdown editor updates the status-strip word count, and typing into the Monaco code editor updates buffer content and caret position.

nodes.name: fixtures.ts
nodes.summary: Defines the shared Playwright fixtures for all Studio E2E tests: launches the Electron app with an isolated throwaway userData directory (optionally pre-seeded with trusted-paths.json), resolves the true main window past the welcome-screen and modal windows, and re-exports test/expect.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Playwright's test.extend with a worker-scoped option fixture (trustedPaths) so suites can seed app state via test.use before launch.

nodes.name: helpers.ts
nodes.summary: Shared E2E helper utilities for identifying modal windows, waiting for newly opened modal windows, opening the first tab from the welcome screen, and locating ribbon buttons behind the overflow menu.

nodes.name: isModalWindow
nodes.summary: Determines whether a Playwright window handle is one of the app's modal/welcome windows by inspecting its URL and closed state.

nodes.name: modalWindow
