nodes.summary: Resolves the freshly opened modal window, either from the app's existing windows or by waiting for the next window event, excluding any previously seen windows.

nodes.name: openTabFromWelcome
nodes.summary: Clicks a named action on the welcome screen's modal window and waits for the resulting view to become visible in the main window — the standard entry step for most E2E suites.

nodes.name: ribbonButton
nodes.summary: Locates a ribbon button by accessible name, expanding the 'More ribbon groups' overflow when the button is collapsed out of view.

nodes.name: panels.e2e.ts
nodes.summary: Playwright E2E suite for panel-layout flows: the ribbon Tools toggle shows and hides the Outline side panel, after first giving the fresh markdown document a heading so the toggle enables.

nodes.name: settings.e2e.ts
nodes.summary: Playwright E2E suite verifying the title-bar settings gear opens the full-bleed settings tab exactly once and disables itself while that tab exists.

nodes.name: shortcuts.e2e.ts
nodes.summary: Playwright E2E suite for keyboard customisation: rebinding a command in the Settings Keyboard section takes effect immediately, with platform-aware handling of the Mod modifier (Meta on macOS, Control elsewhere).

nodes.name: welcome.e2e.ts
nodes.summary: Playwright E2E suite for the welcome-screen window lifecycle: it appears in its own resizable-but-not-maximizable window while the main window stays hidden, dismisses on backdrop click when summoned over tabs, hosts the clear-recent-items confirmation, and opening a markdown file reveals the main window.
nodes.languageNotes: Asserts main-process window state (visibility, bounds, resizable/maximizable flags) via app.browserWindow(...).evaluate rather than through the DOM.

nodes.name: windowChrome
nodes.summary: Reads a window's chrome properties (bounds, resizable, maximizable) from the Electron main process for assertions about welcome-window sizing behaviour.

nodes.name: ci.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions CI workflow running the green gate (Prettier check, ESLint, Vitest with coverage, Angular build, Electron typecheck+bundle) on every PR and pushes to main/release, plus a Playwright+Electron E2E job and an electron-builder packaging smoke test that verifies native modules land outside the asar archive.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses per-ref concurrency cancellation and ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD to avoid the ~100 MB Electron binary in jobs that never launch it; the E2E job runs under xvfb-run.

nodes.name: checks
nodes.summary: Runs the full green gate in sequence: npm ci, format:check, lint, test:coverage (uploading the coverage report as an artifact), Angular renderer build, and Electron main+preload build.

nodes.name: e2e
nodes.summary: Builds the renderer and Electron bundles then runs the Playwright E2E suite against the real Electron binary under xvfb, uploading the Playwright report on failure.

nodes.name: pack
nodes.summary: Packaging smoke test that runs electron-builder --dir and asserts the node-pty binary, ripgrep, the Claude agent SDK executable, and codex vendor binaries are all asar-unpacked, guarding against the per-platform optional-dependency regression.

nodes.name: codeql.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions CodeQL static-analysis workflow scanning the project's JavaScript/TypeScript on PRs and pushes to main/release, plus a weekly Monday schedule so newly published queries are applied to unchanged code.

nodes.name: analyze
nodes.summary: Initializes CodeQL for javascript-typescript and runs the analysis, publishing findings to GitHub code scanning and annotating PR diffs.

nodes.name: pr-title.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub Actions workflow that validates every pull request title against the conventional-commit pattern 'type(scope): subject', because squash merges use the PR title as the commit subject quoted in release notes.

nodes.name: check
nodes.summary: Bash regex check enforcing lower-case type, optional scope, optional breaking-change '!', and a lower-case subject with no trailing full stop; fails the run with an actionable error annotation otherwise.

nodes.name: release.yml
nodes.summary: Release workflow triggered by pushes to the release branch: builds installers for four targets (macOS arm64/x64, Windows x64, Linux x64) on architecture-matched runners, then — only when all builds succeed — creates the v<version> tag via an admin PAT and drafts a GitHub Release holding the artifacts.
nodes.languageNotes: Each matrix entry pins a runner of the target's own architecture and asserts the per-platform optional dependencies (@vscode/ripgrep, @anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk, @openai/codex) are installed before packaging — npm ci resolves them against the host silently, which is how a broken Intel dmg once shipped.

nodes.name: build
nodes.summary: Matrix build job (one entry per platform/arch target) that verifies the target's platform-specific optional packages are on disk, builds the Angular renderer and Electron bundles, packages with electron-builder, and uploads the installers keyed by target id.

nodes.name: release
nodes.summary: Post-build job that reads the app, plugin-API, and curated-catalogue versions from the repo, refuses to overwrite an existing tag, downloads all installer artifacts, creates the v<version> tag with an admin PAT, and drafts the GitHub Release with generated notes and a code-signing caveat.

nodes.name: bug_report.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub issue-form template for bug reports, requiring Studio version, operating system, reproduction steps, and expected-versus-actual behaviour, with guidance to attach the per-session JSONL log from the System Monitor tool for crashes or hangs.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses GitHub's structured issue-forms YAML schema (input, dropdown, textarea body elements with per-field required validations) rather than a freeform markdown template.

nodes.name: config.yml
nodes.summary: Issue-template chooser configuration that disables blank issues and routes questions to GitHub Discussions and security vulnerabilities to private security advisories.

nodes.name: feature_request.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub issue-form template for feature requests that leads with the problem statement before the proposed solution, and classifies requests by product area (Agent/AI, Workbench, editors, workspace, debugging, terminal, source control, plugins, settings, packaging).

nodes.name: PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md
nodes.summary: GitHub pull request template with three sections (what changes and why, how it was verified, checklist) that encodes the project's quality gate: local CI commands, strict TypeScript/TSDoc rules, Angular standalone/signals conventions, architecture invariants, and plugin API versioning discipline.

nodes.name: dependabot.yml
nodes.summary: Dependabot configuration scheduling weekly grouped dependency updates for npm and GitHub Actions, with dedicated groups for Angular, AI SDKs, and xterm packages (which must upgrade as a set), and a deliberate ignore of Electron major versions due to Node ABI rebuilds of node-pty.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Dependabot v2 grouped updates so peer-dependent packages (e.g. @xterm/* core plus addons) arrive as a single installable PR instead of mutually failing individual bumps.

nodes.name: release.yml
nodes.summary: GitHub auto-generated release notes configuration that groups pull requests into changelog categories (new features, improvements, bug fixes, documentation, dependencies) by PR label, excluding duplicate/invalid/wontfix PRs.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Explains the repository governance model: a table describing what each ruleset JSON enforces on main/release and v* tags, why zero approving reviews are required, and the extra repository settings that apply.sh switches on.

nodes.name: apply.sh
nodes.summary: Idempotent admin script that applies repository governance via the gh CLI: upserts every ruleset JSON in this directory by name, sets merge options, enables Dependabot alerts, secret scanning with push protection and Discussions, and creates the release branch if missing.
nodes.languageNotes: Linear bash script with no function definitions; matches existing rulesets by name so PUT-vs-POST keeps re-runs drift-free.

nodes.name: merge-by-admins.json
nodes.summary: GitHub branch ruleset restricting updates to main and release so only repository admins can merge; anyone may open a PR, but the admin RepositoryRole is the sole bypass actor for the update rule.

nodes.name: protect-main-release.json
nodes.summary: GitHub branch ruleset with no bypass actors: main and release accept changes only via a PR whose 'Format · Lint · Test · Build' status check passed, with deletion and force-push blocked and merge limited to merge/squash methods.

nodes.name: release-tags.json
nodes.summary: GitHub tag ruleset locking v* tags so only repository admins (the release workflow's admin token) can create, update, or delete them; force-pushes are blocked for everyone else.

nodes.name: fingerprints.json
nodes.summary: Generated cache of per-file content hashes and extracted structural data (functions, classes, imports, exports) from a prior understand-anything analysis run, used to detect changed files and enable incremental re-analysis.
nodes.languageNotes: Keyed by project-relative path; each entry pairs a SHA-256 contentHash with the structural extraction snapshot for that file, plus the gitCommitHash of the analyzed tree.

nodes.name: knowledge-graph.json
nodes.summary: Generated knowledge graph artifact from a previous understand-anything analysis (2026-07-04) of onixlabs-studio, containing project metadata, graph nodes and edges, architectural layers, and a guided tour definition.
nodes.languageNotes: Top-level sections: version, project (name/languages/frameworks), nodes, edges, layers, and tour — the complete serialized output of the analysis pipeline.

nodes.name: meta.json
nodes.summary: Small run-metadata record for the understand-anything analysis, storing the last analysis timestamp, the git commit hash of the analyzed tree, the tool version, and the count of analyzed files (537).

nodes.name: CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md
nodes.summary: Contributor Covenant code of conduct defining community standards, enforcement responsibilities, and a four-tier enforcement ladder from correction to permanent ban.

nodes.name: CONTRIBUTING.md
nodes.summary: Contribution guide covering setup, the mandatory pre-push 'green gate' (format, lint, coverage, build), the PR-only path to main, commit title conventions, plugin API versioning, AI-assisted contribution policy, and CalVer releases.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Project overview for ONIXLabs Studio, a cross-platform Electron + Angular IDE with an agentic AI core, covering feature highlights, technology stack, install/run/build/package commands, and the src/ project structure.

nodes.name: SECURITY.md
nodes.summary: Security policy describing how to privately report vulnerabilities, what is in scope, and which versions receive fixes.

nodes.name: angular.json
nodes.summary: Angular CLI workspace configuration defining the application build (browser entry src/shared/app/main.ts, Monaco/xterm/KaTeX/Phosphor global styles and assets), dev-server, and unit-test targets with coverage thresholds and bundle budgets.
nodes.languageNotes: Unit-test target sets vitest isolate:true explicitly — the @angular/build:unit-test default of shared jsdom state previously caused flaky specs.

nodes.name: electron-builder.yml
nodes.summary: Single source of truth for desktop packaging: ships dist-electron and the built Angular app in an asar (with node-pty, Claude/Codex SDKs, and ripgrep unpacked), registers OS file associations, and defines dmg/zip, NSIS, and AppImage targets per platform.
nodes.languageNotes: asarUnpack is required for native modules and self-spawning CLI binaries; publish is disabled so the release workflow controls artifact uploads.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: npm manifest for the CalVer-versioned Electron app: declares the compiled main entry (dist-electron/electron/main.js), esbuild scripts that bundle the Electron main and preload from src/shared/electron, Angular build/test/lint scripts, packaging scripts, and AI SDK, Monaco, xterm, and node-pty dependencies.
nodes.languageNotes: postinstall runs electron-rebuild for node-pty only; the electron-builder config lives entirely in electron-builder.yml, not a package.json build key.

nodes.name: tsconfig.app.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript project config for the Angular renderer build: includes src/shared and src/features sources while excluding specs and all Electron-process code from typechecking.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Root TypeScript solution config enabling strict mode and strict Angular templates, defining the @shared/* and @features/* path aliases, and referencing the app, spec, and Electron sub-projects.
nodes.languageNotes: files is empty — this is a solution-style config; actual compilation happens through the three referenced tsconfig projects, so the root does not typecheck src/shared/electron.

nodes.name: panel-layout-overlay.html
nodes.summary: Angular template for the panel drag-and-drop overlay: renders the accent-tinted docking preview rectangle, per-edge docking guide icons (highlighting the hot edge), and a translucent ghost of the panel being dragged, all driven by signals.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Angular's built-in control flow (@if/@for) with signal reads and `as` aliasing; positions elements via [style.*.px] bindings from computed rects.

nodes.name: panel-layout-overlay.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the viewport-fixed drag overlay: pointer-events-none full-screen layer with accent-bordered preview rectangle, edge guide badges that invert colours when hot, and a shadowed semi-transparent ghost mirroring the shared panel surface in both themes.
nodes.languageNotes: The :host renders as display:contents so the overlay never becomes a grid item of the owning layout; theme variables are re-derived via :host-context([data-theme-mode='dark']).

nodes.name: panel-layout.html
nodes.summary: Angular template for the side-panel layout shell: a main content slot surrounded by four edge wrappers (left/right/top/bottom), each with a resize grip wired to mousedown handlers, a hidden staging area where projected app-panel children land before being re-homed, and the drag overlay component.
nodes.languageNotes: Panels are projected once into a never-rendered staging area and immediately re-homed into their edge's wrapper by the component class; grips use role=separator with aria-orientation for accessibility.

nodes.name: panel-layout.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the panel layout's 3x3 grid: left/right edges span full height while top/bottom fit the centre column, edge wrappers tile docked panels as flex stacks (left edge reversed so order 0 stays innermost), and absolutely positioned grips overlap each stack's inner edge with hover/active accent states.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines --panel-grip-hover-color on :host for descendant panels to consume; empty edges collapse to zero so the centre takes remaining space, and top/bottom edges are capped at 50vh.

nodes.name: panel.html
nodes.summary: Minimal Angular template for a single edge-docked panel: an optional accessible divider (role=separator) for rebalancing adjacent stack members, plus a content slot that projects the hosted view.

nodes.name: panel.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for an edge-docked panel: paints the shared panel surface as chrome for the projected view, absolutely positions the divider over the panel's centre-facing edge (right side on the reversed left edge) with hover/drag colours, and clamps side columns to half the viewport width.
nodes.languageNotes: Divider placement is switched via :host([data-edge=...]) attribute selectors; the 50vw max-inline-size mirrors the resize clamp so stored widths stay bounded in smaller windows.

nodes.name: _base.scss
nodes.summary: Global reset and baseline styles: box-sizing, accent-tinted text selection, the fixed 100vh app body, and the app-wide keyboard-focus policy (a single accent focus ring, with form controls recolouring their border instead).
nodes.languageNotes: Defines the app-wide :focus-visible treatment centrally so components only override it when they need a tighter offset.

nodes.name: _breakpoints.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the debugger's breakpoint glyphs in Monaco's glyph margin: filled dots, hollow rings for conditional breakpoints, and a distinct colour for logpoints, all drawn with radial gradients so no image assets are needed.
nodes.languageNotes: Must be global because Monaco renders decorations into its own DOM, outside Angular's view encapsulation.

nodes.name: _change-margin.scss
nodes.summary: The Visual-Studio-style save-state change bars in Monaco's line-decorations lane: unsaved/saved vertical stripes pinned to the lane's left edge, plus a downward caret marking deleted lines.

nodes.name: _debug-execution.scss
nodes.summary: The current-execution-line marker shown while a debuggee is paused: an amber whole-line tint (theme-adjusted for dark mode) plus a clip-path triangle arrow in Monaco's glyph margin.

nodes.name: _drag.scss
nodes.summary: Angular CDK drag-and-drop styling for title-strip tab dragging: the .tab-chip drag preview that mirrors an active tab's full silhouette (including the concave corner 'feet' meeting the rail) so a dragged tab rides along the strip.
nodes.languageNotes: Global because the CDK renders drag previews and placeholders on <body>, outside the originating component's DOM.

nodes.name: _folding.scss
nodes.summary: Monaco code-folding chrome overrides styled to match Visual Studio: replaces Monaco's chevron glyphs with bordered plus/minus boxes and positions the fold control to the right of the change-margin bar in the shared decorations lane.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses !important throughout because Monaco injects its own gutter CSS into the document head at runtime, after this bundled stylesheet.

nodes.name: _icons.scss
nodes.summary: Documentation-only partial for the icon system: explains that Phosphor Icons are consumed through the app-icon component and Icon token, and that the webfont stylesheets are registered in angular.json rather than imported here.

nodes.name: _list.scss
nodes.summary: Shared row chrome for the reusable ListView component (used by the agent conversation history): row hover fill, accent-tinted selection, inset focus ring, drag-reorder states, and the empty-list placeholder, deliberately mirroring the tree's look.

nodes.name: _menu.scss
nodes.summary: All popup-menu surfaces rendered through the Angular CDK overlay: the title-strip tab menu, the generic app-menu-panel (items, tones, checks, carets), and the LSP status drop-up, sharing one menu look across the app.
nodes.languageNotes: Global because CDK overlays attach menu panels outside the originating component's DOM, beyond view encapsulation.

nodes.name: _milkdown.scss
nodes.summary: Theme overrides for the Milkdown/Crepe WYSIWYG markdown editor: maps Crepe's --crepe-color-* palette onto the app's gray primitives and accent via light/dark mixins, scoped to app-markdown-editor so every embedding is themed identically, plus block drag-reorder styling.
nodes.languageNotes: Exposes milkdown-light-colors/milkdown-dark-colors as SCSS mixins so the print stylesheet can reuse the light palette without duplicating it.

nodes.name: _panel.scss
nodes.summary: Helper classes for content projected into the shared panel tool-strip and status strip: the toolbar spacer, the compact accent-surface icon button matching the ribbon/title-strip buttons, and status items.

nodes.name: _print.scss
nodes.summary: Print and Export-to-PDF styles: hides the app chrome, collapses the fixed 100vh viewport so the document paginates naturally, and forces the Milkdown light palette so dark-mode sessions still print on white; page margins are owned by the Printing service's @page rewrite.

nodes.name: _status-strip.scss
nodes.summary: Status-strip refinements that must cross component boundaries: a slightly larger icon size cascaded to every app-icon in the strip, and an etched groove separator drawn between adjacent status segments.

nodes.name: _textures.scss
nodes.summary: The optional workspace background patterns for appearance.workspaceTexture: eleven Hero Patterns SVGs as data-URI masks on app-dock-container, painted in the theme's texture colour so each pattern follows the accent and light/dark palette.
nodes.languageNotes: Patterns are applied as CSS masks rather than background images, so only the SVG's alpha matters and the colour comes from the theme.

nodes.name: _theme-dark.scss
nodes.summary: The dark theme as a single SCSS mixin: maps every UI surface token (title strip, tabs, scrollbars, accent surfaces, dock, menus) onto the gray primitive scale and accent for dark mode.

nodes.name: _theme-light.scss
nodes.summary: The light theme as a single SCSS mixin: the light-mode counterpart of the dark theme, mapping the same UI surface tokens onto the gray primitives and accent.

nodes.name: _theme.scss
nodes.summary: Theme switch point: applies the theme-light and theme-dark mixins under the [data-theme-mode] attribute that the Theme service writes to the document root after resolving 'system' to a concrete mode.

nodes.name: _tree.scss
nodes.summary: Shared row chrome for the reusable TreeView component (File Explorer, Solution Explorer, source-control Repository panel): rows, chevrons, icons, hover-revealed row actions, virtual-scroll sizing, loading spinner, and empty states.
nodes.languageNotes: Global because TreeView owns the row chrome while consumers project row content into it, so one definition must cover both DOMs.

nodes.name: _variables.scss
nodes.summary: The app's root design-token layer: the corner-shape/squircle feature gate with round-corner fallback, border-radius multipliers, tab-foot geometry knobs, the reduced-GPU mode, and the :root primitives (gray scale, accent, shared sizing tokens like the change-margin width).
nodes.languageNotes: Every corner-shape declaration resolves var(--app-corner-shape, <default>), letting data-corners='round' on <html> fall the whole app back to plain rounded rectangles at runtime for GPUs that corrupt superellipse masks.

nodes.name: _views.scss
nodes.summary: Shared placeholder styling for not-yet-implemented tab views: a centred icon-and-message column using the view-placeholder colour token.

nodes.name: bash-language-server.lock.json
nodes.summary: npm lockfile (lockfileVersion 3) pinning bash-language-server 5.6.0 and its 41-package dependency tree with exact resolved URLs and integrity hashes, enabling deterministic offline provisioning of the Bash LSP plugin without running npm.
nodes.languageNotes: lockfileVersion 3 stores flat (path, resolved URL, integrity) triples under a single packages map, so the installer can reify node_modules directly from tarball fetches.

nodes.name: dockerfile-language-server.lock.json
nodes.summary: npm lockfile pinning dockerfile-language-server-nodejs 0.15.0 (docker-langserver binary) and its 12-package dependency tree with resolved URLs and integrity hashes for deterministic provisioning of the Dockerfile LSP plugin.

nodes.name: svelte-language-server.lock.json
nodes.summary: npm lockfile pinning svelte-language-server 0.18.4 (svelteserver binary) and its 55-package dependency tree — the largest of the bundled server lockfiles — with resolved URLs and integrity hashes for deterministic provisioning of the Svelte LSP plugin.

nodes.name: vscode-langservers-extracted.lock.json
nodes.summary: npm lockfile pinning vscode-langservers-extracted 4.10.0, which bundles five VS Code-derived language servers (CSS, ESLint, HTML, JSON, Markdown) in one package, plus its 34-package dependency tree for deterministic plugin provisioning.
nodes.languageNotes: A single lockfile provisions five distinct LSP binaries (vscode-css/eslint/html/json/markdown-language-server) exposed by one npm package.

nodes.name: yaml-language-server.lock.json
nodes.summary: npm lockfile pinning yaml-language-server 1.24.0 and its 21-package dependency tree with resolved URLs and integrity hashes for deterministic provisioning of the YAML LSP plugin.

nodes.name: settings.json
nodes.summary: Claude Code project settings that enable the understand-anything plugin for this repository.

nodes.name: SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Claude Code skill describing how to build, launch and drive ONIXLabs Studio at runtime via Chrome DevTools Protocol using playwright-core, including UI gotchas (mount-all/hide-inactive views, ribbon overflow flyouts, localStorage layout keys) and scenarios worth driving.

nodes.name: CODEOWNERS
nodes.summary: GitHub code-ownership file assigning @MrMatthewLayton as owner of every path, so pull-request reviews are automatically requested from him.

nodes.name: .nvmrc
nodes.summary: Pins the project's Node.js version to 24.16.0 for nvm-based toolchain consistency.

nodes.name: .prettierignore
nodes.summary: Excludes build outputs (dist, dist-electron, release), dependencies, coverage, vendored resources and tool state directories from Prettier formatting and the format:check gate.

nodes.name: .understandignore
nodes.summary: Gitignore-style pattern file controlling which files the understand-anything analysis pipeline skips; currently almost entirely commented-out suggestions mirroring the project's .gitignore.

nodes.name: scan-result.json
nodes.summary: Generated intermediate output of the understand-anything project scanner: the full file inventory, detected languages, and resolved import map that downstream knowledge-graph analysis batches consume.

nodes.name: agents.md
nodes.summary: Agent guide pointing to the project wiki for full documentation and listing the ten enforced non-negotiable rules: feature isolation, no feature code in shared, untrusted renderer, agent write confinement, control atoms, plugin API versioning, strict TypeScript, the green gate, and PR-only main.

nodes.name: playwright.config.ts
nodes.summary: Playwright configuration for the end-to-end suite that drives the real built Electron application: one worker, serial execution, 60s timeout, with CI-aware retries and an HTML reporter.
nodes.languageNotes: Runs one Electron instance at a time (fullyParallel: false, workers: 1) because tests drive a real desktop app rather than isolated browser contexts.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration for the Playwright E2E suite, extending the root tsconfig with Node types; ESLint's projectService resolves e2e sources through it while Playwright transpiles tests with its own loader.

nodes.name: eslint.config.js
nodes.summary: ESLint flat config enforcing the project's strict baseline — explicit member accessibility, no any, total type annotations, no floating promises, Angular selector conventions — and generating a per-feature no-restricted-imports block that bans cross-feature imports (the INV2 feature-isolation invariant).
nodes.languageNotes: Feature-isolation boundaries are generated programmatically: one flat-config block per feature maps sibling @features/* paths into a banned import group with an explanatory message.

nodes.name: agent-ribbon.html
nodes.summary: Agent ribbon template with Session (New Chat, Stop, Compact, Remote Control toggle), View (Scroll to Bottom, History), Engine (provider-and-model and autonomy-mode fields) and Attachments (file, folder, selection) groups, plus the remote-control confirmation modal.

nodes.name: agent-view.html
nodes.summary: Agent tab template placing the chat shell as the main pane of an app-panel-layout, with the Conversation History tool panel docked to the right edge when history is open.

nodes.name: agent-view.scss
nodes.summary: Host styles for the agent view that fill the tab body; deliberately avoids setting display on app-panel-layout because a parent-scoped rule would outrank the layout component's own grid and collapse the docked history panel.

nodes.name: api-explorer-ribbon.html
nodes.summary: API Explorer ribbon template with a File group (Save menu button with variants) and a New group offering the three building blocks of a collection: Collection, Environment and Request.

nodes.name: api-explorer-view.html
nodes.summary: API Explorer tab template hosting the dock container plus the view-level New Collection and New Environment naming modals, which both the panel's more-actions menu and the ribbon's New group can raise.

nodes.name: api-explorer-view.scss
nodes.summary: Minimal host styles making the API Explorer tab a full-height dock surface, mirroring how a workspace tab fills its body.

nodes.name: api-environment-panel.html
nodes.summary: Environment panel template editing the active environment: a rename text field, a property grid for its variables, and a hint explaining the {{variable}} reference syntax; shows a fallback message when no environment is active.

nodes.name: api-environment-panel.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the environment variable editor panel: a scrolling column layout with muted hint text and monospace inline code for variable syntax examples.

nodes.name: api-explorer-panel.html
nodes.summary: API Explorer tree panel template: the shared explorer toolbar over a virtualized tree view with per-kind row rendering (HTTP method badge for requests, icons for environments and collections, an active-environment marker), plus the row-scoped Rename and Delete confirmation modals.

nodes.name: api-explorer-panel.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the API Explorer tree panel: layout-only dialog styling and method/active badges, deliberately leaving toolbar and tree row appearance to the shared app-explorer-toolbar and app-tree-view components.

nodes.name: api-history-panel.html
nodes.summary: Send-history panel template listing one row per sent request (result tone, method, name, duration, timestamp, URL) with click-to-reopen and a Clear action; shows an empty-state message when nothing has been sent.

nodes.name: api-history-panel.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the send-history panel: a scrolling newest-first list where each row is a full-width button carrying the result badge, method, name and timing metadata.

nodes.name: api-request-panel.html
nodes.summary: Request editor panel template: an owned tool strip with the request name and Send/Cancel, the method-and-URL send bar with variable-resolved URL preview, tabbed sections for params, headers, auth (bearer/basic/api-key) and body, and the response area showing status, timing, size, headers or pretty-printed body.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Angular built-in control flow (@if/@switch/@for) throughout, an @let alias for row data, and a shared ng-template so form and url-encoded bodies reuse one property grid.

nodes.name: api-request-panel.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the request editor panel: fixed tool-strip chrome above a single scrolling column holding both request and response, a deliberate one-scroll design instead of a hand-rolled splitter.

nodes.name: binary-disasm-panel.html
nodes.summary: Template for the binary editor's disassembly tool panel: a read-only app-text-editor showing assembly inside the shared app-tool-panel chrome, with an empty-state message when the file format has no native disassembly.

nodes.name: binary-disasm-panel.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the disassembly panel: fills the tool panel's flush body with an absolutely positioned editor, centers the no-disassembly empty state, and pierces view encapsulation via ::ng-deep to highlight Monaco lines whose bytes are selected in the hex grid.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses ::ng-deep because Monaco renders the highlighted line element outside the component's Angular view encapsulation.

nodes.name: binary-inspector.html
nodes.summary: Template for the binary inspector tool panel: endianness and signedness app-button-group toggles above a definition list of interpreted values for the selected byte, with a prompt when nothing is selected.

nodes.name: binary-inspector.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the binary inspector: a dense scrollable flex column filling the tool panel's flush body, with muted labels, a monospace right-aligned value column, and hairline row separators.

nodes.name: binary-ribbon.html
nodes.summary: Ribbon template for the binary editor with File, Edit, Navigate, Layout, and Tools strip groups: save, cut/copy with variant menus, undo/redo, insert-mode toggle, start/end/code navigation, a bytes-per-row field, and toggles that show the disassembly, inspector, and agent panels.

nodes.name: binary-agent-panel.html
nodes.summary: Template for the binary view's docked Agent tool panel, embedding the shared app-agent-conversation-panel with surface 'binary' and the current file context once a tab id is available.

nodes.name: binary-agent-panel.scss
nodes.summary: Sizing-only styles for the binary agent panel host; deliberately avoids setting display on the embedded conversation panel so its own :host flex layout is not overridden and the chat does not overflow the tool strip.
nodes.languageNotes: Styling a child component by tag selector outranks that component's own :host rule, so this file intentionally sets only block-size.

nodes.name: binary-view.html
nodes.summary: Layout template for the binary tab view: an app-panel-layout with the hex app-binary-editor in the main slot and lazily mounted right-docked panels for disassembly, inspector, and agent, each wired to the document's signals and only added to the DOM on first show.

nodes.name: binary-view.scss
nodes.summary: Minimal host styles for the binary view: full-height block sized to the tab with the standard body background and foreground colors.

nodes.name: code-document-panel.html
nodes.summary: Thin wrapper template hosting app-code-document inside the document well panel, forwarding ready, cursor, EOL, and selection events up to the panel component.

nodes.name: code-document-panel.scss
nodes.summary: Flex-column fill styles ensuring the wrapped app-code-document stretches to the document panel's full height without collapsing.

nodes.name: code-document.html
nodes.summary: Template for the document-bound code editor core: an app-text-editor bound to the document's content and language signals, a floating breakpoint editor for condition/logpoint/enabled settings, and a hidden print-only full-file mirror that works around Monaco's virtualized DOM when printing.
nodes.languageNotes: Monaco only materializes visible lines, so a screen-hidden <pre> mirror of the whole document is swapped in by the print stylesheet to paginate the entire file.

nodes.name: code-document.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the code document core: dual 100%-plus-flex sizing so it fills both the tab view's definite-height slot and the document well's flex slot, hides the print mirror on screen, and draws the floating breakpoint editor overlay with light and dark theme variants.

nodes.name: code-ribbon.html
nodes.summary: Ribbon template for the code editor with File, Edit, Language, View, and Tools groups: save and print variant menus, clipboard and undo/redo/find buttons, run and syntax-language selection with format, word wrap/minimap/line-number checks, and terminal/agent panel launchers.

nodes.name: code-agent-panel.html
nodes.summary: Template for the code view's docked Agent tool panel, embedding the shared app-agent-conversation-panel with the tab id, activity state, and current file context.

nodes.name: code-agent-panel.scss
nodes.summary: Sizing-only styles for the code agent panel host; intentionally leaves display unset on the embedded conversation panel so its own flex layout survives and the chat stays inside the tool strip.

nodes.name: code-terminal-panel.html
nodes.summary: Template for the code view's docked Terminal tool panel: layout-move, cut, copy, and clear action buttons projected into the shared panel header's action slot, with an app-terminal bound to the tab's run terminal filling the body.

nodes.name: code-terminal-panel.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the terminal panel body: a custom-property-driven terminal surface background a shade below the shared header, with a dark-theme override and full-height fill of the tool panel's flush body.

nodes.name: code-view.html
nodes.summary: Layout template for the code tab view: an app-panel-layout with app-code-document in the main slot, lazily mounted terminal (bottom) and agent (right) docked panels, and a Find panel driven by the view's FindAdapter.

nodes.name: code-view.scss
nodes.summary: Host sizing styles for the code view whose background matches the Monaco editor surface (with a dark-theme variant) so any gap before the editor lays out reads as part of the page; panel arrangement itself is owned by app-panel-layout.

nodes.name: containers-ribbon.html
nodes.summary: Ribbon template for the Containers view: tone-colored Start/Stop/Remove container actions gated on selection and running state, Logs and Shell terminal launchers, and a Refresh button.

nodes.name: containers-view.html
nodes.summary: Template for the Docker Containers dashboard: availability empty states (connecting, or Docker-not-running with a Start Docker action), container and image list sections with per-row logs/shell/start/stop/remove buttons, and a bottom-docked terminal panel hosting tabbed logs and shell sessions managed by ContainerTerminals.

nodes.name: containers-view.scss
nodes.summary: Complete styling for the Containers dashboard: scrollable list sections with BEM rows, a running-state indicator dot, hover-revealed row actions, empty-state layouts, and the docked terminal region's tab strip and stacked panes.

nodes.name: markdown-document-panel.html
nodes.summary: Thin wrapper template hosting app-markdown-document inside the document well panel, passing through the document id, activity, and remove-on-destroy flags.

nodes.name: markdown-document-panel.scss
nodes.summary: Flex-column fill styles ensuring the wrapped app-markdown-document stretches to the document panel's full height without collapsing.

nodes.name: markdown-document.html
nodes.summary: Template for the document-bound markdown core: a single app-markdown-editor bound to the document's content, read-only state, and base directory, relaying ready, content-change, selection-change, and save events to the component.

nodes.name: markdown-document.scss
nodes.summary: Styles making the markdown document core a pass-through flex container so the shared markdown editor pane fills whatever slot the hosting leaf provides instead of collapsing to zero height.

nodes.name: insert-modal.scss
nodes.summary: Shared form styling for the markdown ribbon's Insert-group modals (link, image, emoji, math, footnote, collapse), giving titles, labelled fields, inputs, textareas, and field-plus-button rows a consistent themed look inside the reusable app-modal panel.

nodes.name: markdown-ribbon.html
nodes.summary: Template for the markdown editor's ribbon: File (save/print), Edit (cut/copy/paste with variant menus, undo/redo/find), formatting, and Insert command groups built from the shared ribbon strip atoms, with overlay hosts for the insert modals.

nodes.name: markdown-ribbon.scss
nodes.summary: Markdown-ribbon-specific styles: spacing between the Format group's style field and its button row, and absolute positioning that removes the full-screen insert-modal overlay hosts from the ribbon's flex flow.

nodes.name: markdown-view.html
nodes.summary: Template for the markdown tab view: an app-panel-layout hosting the markdown document core in the main slot with conditionally opened Outline, Review, and Reader tool panels, each an independently dockable app-panel that can tile alongside the others.

nodes.name: markdown-view.scss
nodes.summary: Minimal host sizing for the markdown view: fills the tab, hides overflow, and stretches the embedded markdown document core, deferring editor scroll and theming to the shared editor pane and panel layout.

nodes.name: markdown-outline-panel.html
nodes.summary: Template for the Outline tool panel: a heading list rendered inside app-tool-panel with an SVG stepped connector, an active-position marker, per-level indented buttons that jump to headings, and an empty state when the document has no headings.

nodes.name: markdown-outline-panel.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the Outline panel: theme-aware connector-line colour custom property, positioning for the SVG connector overlay and active marker, and indented, truncating heading rows with active and hover states.

nodes.name: markdown-reader-panel.html
nodes.summary: Template for the Reader (read-aloud) tool panel: play/pause and paragraph skip transport buttons, a progress scrubber with elapsed/total time labels, and speed and highlight controls built from shared button atoms.

nodes.name: markdown-reader-panel.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the Reader panel: stacked transport, scrubber, and control rows, including a custom range-input scrubber whose filled track is driven by a --ra-fill custom property.

nodes.name: markdown-review-panel.html
nodes.summary: Template for the Review tool panel: filter chips per issue kind (spelling, grammar, style) with counts, a re-check button, and a card list of issues showing in-context flagged text with reveal-in-document and suggestion actions.

nodes.name: markdown-review-panel.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the Review panel: per-kind accent colours (spelling/grammar/style) exposed as a --rv-color custom property that tints chips, dots, kind labels, and flagged words, plus toolbar, card list, and action layout.

nodes.name: an-array-of-english-words.d.ts
nodes.summary: Ambient module declaration typing the an-array-of-english-words package as a default-exported string array, so the markdown review spelling engine can lazily import the bundled English word list under strict TypeScript.
nodes.languageNotes: A declare-module ambient declaration providing types for an untyped JSON word-list package.

nodes.name: mission-control-ribbon.html
nodes.summary: Template for the Mission Control ribbon: a danger-toned Stop All agents command plus a View group with Reset Widths and three toggle filters (Hide Empty, Hide Idle, Hide Working) that partition the agent columns by run state.

nodes.name: mission-control-agent-tile.html
nodes.summary: Template for a single live agent column in Mission Control: an identity header (icon, tab-link title, branch line), a pulse-dot run status, a tri-state default-run launch/stop button, and the embedded live agent transcript body.

nodes.name: mission-control-agent-tile.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the Mission Control agent tile: flex-basis column sizing that grows to fill but holds width once the row overflows, header/identity/status layout, a trailing resize grip, and the seam separating adjacent columns.

nodes.name: mission-control-panel.html
nodes.summary: Template for the Mission Control side rail: a reorderable app-list-view of live agents where each row shows icon, title, branch, waiting state, and run status, scrolling the matching column into view on click, with an empty state when no agents are active.

nodes.name: mission-control-panel.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the Mission Control side rail: surface-less header-over-body column layout so it reads as part of the hosting panel, plus rail row alignment, waiting-state accents, and empty-state presentation.

nodes.name: mission-control-view.html
nodes.summary: Template for the Mission Control tab: an app-panel-layout whose main area renders each live agent host as a dynamically injected tile via ngComponentOutlet in a scrolling row, alongside a left-docked permissions panel hosting the agent rail.

nodes.name: mission-control-view.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the Mission Control view: tab-filling host, the horizontally scrolling row that hosts the agent columns and its trailing spacer, and centred empty-state messaging.

nodes.name: model-manager-ribbon.html
nodes.summary: Template for the AI Model Manager ribbon: a Runtime group whose Start button swaps to Stop while the local model server is running, plus a Refresh command, all gated on the busy state.

nodes.name: model-manager-view.html
nodes.summary: Template for the AI Model Manager view: a runtime header showing server state, install provenance, and install/start/stop controls, followed by the installed and loaded model tables that populate once the local model server is running.

nodes.name: model-manager-view.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the AI Model Manager view: a scrolling column with the runtime header (state indicator, description, and controls) pinned above the installed and loaded model tables, including running/stopped indicator states.

nodes.name: plugin-manager-ribbon.html
nodes.summary: Template for the Plugin Manager ribbon: a single Plugins group with a busy-gated Refresh command built from the shared ribbon strip atoms.

nodes.name: plugin-manager-view.html
nodes.summary: Template for the Plugins view: an app-table listing available plugins with install state, description, and per-row actions, plus an installed-count header noting that choosing between duplicate providers happens in Settings.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Angular control-flow syntax (@if/@for) and the shared app-table with an appTableRow row template.

nodes.name: plugin-manager-view.scss
nodes.summary: Stylesheet for the Plugin Manager view, laying out the header, error banner, and plugin table columns (name, description, install status and actions) with BEM-style class naming.

nodes.name: accent-picker.html
nodes.summary: Template for the accent colour picker in Settings: a preset dropdown that, when Custom is selected, reveals hue and saturation sliders with live track gradients.
nodes.languageNotes: Sliders receive computed trackBackground gradients so the control itself previews the colour range.

nodes.name: accent-picker.scss
nodes.summary: Stylesheet for the accent colour picker, stacking the dropdown above the custom hue/saturation slider fields with labelled rows.

nodes.name: editor-profiles.html
nodes.summary: Template for editor language profiles in Settings: an accordion per profile with a language multi-select and per-setting override rows, each gated by a checkbox that enables the override control.
nodes.languageNotes: A lint suppression documents that the label wraps a projected native input across a component boundary, which the template lint rule cannot verify statically.

nodes.name: editor-profiles.scss
nodes.summary: Stylesheet for the editor language profiles section, laying out the header with its Add-profile button and the per-profile override rows inside accordions.

nodes.name: language-server-settings.html
nodes.summary: Template for per-language language-server settings: shows which installed server serves the language, offers a provider dropdown only when more than one server is installed, and exposes an enable toggle and server-specific options.
nodes.languageNotes: Embodies the plugin-slot rule that a choice between providers is only surfaced once two implementations are actually installed.

nodes.name: language-server-settings.scss
nodes.summary: Stylesheet for the per-language language-server settings block, styling its header, title, and subtitle above the setting rows.

nodes.name: ai-connection-editor.html
nodes.summary: Template for editing a single AI provider connection: display name, conditional base URL for OpenAI-compatible endpoints, API-key entry with stored-credential status, and provider-specific authentication fields.
nodes.languageNotes: Fields appear conditionally per connection kind (showBaseUrl, usesKey), so one editor template serves every provider type.

nodes.name: ai-connection-editor.scss
nodes.summary: Stylesheet for the AI connection editor, laying out the credential hint, wide URL/key fields, and status/action rows within a connection's expandable editor.

nodes.name: ai-network-locations.html
nodes.summary: Template for the agent network allowlist: an add-host field with wildcard-domain support and a removable list of allowed hosts, with inline validation errors. The description documents sandbox coverage and the Codex all-or-nothing caveat.

nodes.name: ai-network-locations.scss
nodes.summary: Stylesheet for the agent network allowlist, styling the add-entry row, error message, and the removable host list items.

nodes.name: ai-remote-notifications.html
nodes.summary: Single setting row toggling remote-control push notifications: pushes to the user's phone via Claude Code's mobile push when a remote-controlled agent needs a permission decision or an answer.

nodes.name: ai-settings.html
nodes.summary: Template for the AI settings section, switched by sub-view into General (auto-scroll, background task reporting, token cap, run timeout), Security & Permissions, and Agents & Providers groups, embedding the remote-notifications, tool-policies, write-paths, network-locations, and connection-editor child components.
nodes.languageNotes: Most rows delegate to app-setting-control keyed into the settings registry (e.g. ai.autoScroll), so the template declares only labels and descriptions.

nodes.name: ai-settings.scss
nodes.summary: Stylesheet for the AI settings section: plain stacked .ai-group rows per sub-section, first-row divider suppression against the shared section rule, and hand-laid-out styling for the expandable connection manager list.

nodes.name: ai-tool-policies.html
nodes.summary: Template rendering one setting row per agent tool, each with a permission-policy dropdown that sets how that tool's use is allowed, prompted for, or denied.

nodes.name: ai-tool-policies.scss
nodes.summary: Minimal stylesheet stacking the per-tool policy rows in the AI tool-policies component.

nodes.name: ai-write-paths.html
nodes.summary: Template for the agent write-confinement allowlist: an Add-folder picker and removable list of absolute directories the agent may write to beyond the workspace root.

nodes.name: ai-write-paths.scss
nodes.summary: Stylesheet for the agent write-paths allowlist, styling the grouped setting row and the removable path list items.

nodes.name: keyboard-settings.html
nodes.summary: Template for the Keyboard settings section: bindings grouped by view, each row showing the description, a chord button that enters live key-capture mode on click, and a Reset button when the default has been overridden.
nodes.languageNotes: The chord button captures keydown only while in editing mode and cancels capture on blur, keeping the capture state per-binding.

nodes.name: keyboard-settings.scss
nodes.summary: Stylesheet for the Keyboard settings section, styling view group headings, binding rows, and the chord button's normal, editing, and overridden states.

nodes.name: section.scss
nodes.summary: Shared layout stylesheet for every settings section: a vertical flex stack of app-setting-row elements with a hairline divider between consecutive rows.
nodes.languageNotes: Applied via each section component's :host, so section-specific stylesheets sometimes suppress its divider on their first row.

nodes.name: source-control-settings.html
nodes.summary: Template for the Source Control settings section: a GitHub personal-access-token field with Save/Clear/Recheck actions, plus explanatory rows on OS-secure-storage encryption and the gh CLI fallback precedence.

nodes.name: source-control-settings.scss
nodes.summary: Stylesheet for the Source Control settings section, laying out the token field and its Save/Clear/Recheck button row.

nodes.name: terminal-settings.html
nodes.summary: Template for the Terminal settings section: a single setting row with a dropdown choosing the default shell for new terminals from those installed on the system.

nodes.name: setting-control.html
nodes.summary: Angular template that switches a single setting's editor by kind — toggle, text field, number field, dropdown, button group, or accent picker — binding each control atom to the setting's current value and change handler.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Angular's @switch control flow to pick one control atom per setting kind, keeping the settings registry data-driven.

nodes.name: settings-section.html
nodes.summary: Template that renders a settings section as a list of setting rows — one app-setting-control per registered setting — with an optional footer hint (e.g. restart-required notes).

nodes.name: settings-section.scss
nodes.summary: Minimal stylesheet for the settings section component, styling only the muted explanatory hint shown beneath a section's settings.

nodes.name: settings-view.html
nodes.summary: Top-level Settings view template: a tree-view navigation of sections beside a content pane that switches among registry-driven sections, specialized panels (terminal, source control, keyboard, language servers), and per-provider AI settings, with a restart-required banner offering relaunch.
nodes.languageNotes: A large @switch maps each selected section id to either a generic app-settings-section or a bespoke settings component, including one case per AI provider.

nodes.name: settings-view.scss
nodes.summary: Stylesheet for the full-bleed Settings view: a flex split between the framed left section-navigation tree and the scrolling right content pane, plus breadcrumb title styling and the pinned restart banner.

nodes.name: metric-tile.html
nodes.summary: Template for a System Monitor metric card: a label/value header that can show paired SYS and APP readings, over one or more captioned channels each rendering an app-sparkline graph.

nodes.name: metric-tile.scss
nodes.summary: Stylesheet for the metric tile card: bordered panel surface, header layout with stacked SYS/APP readings, and flex-filling sparkline channel areas.

nodes.name: sparkline.html
nodes.summary: SVG template for the sparkline component, drawing a system-series line and area fill plus an optional overlaid app-series line and area from computed path signals.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses preserveAspectRatio="none" with vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" so the SVG stretches to its tile while stroke width stays crisp.

nodes.name: sparkline.scss
nodes.summary: Stylesheet coloring the sparkline: the SYS series takes the accent color with a faint area wash, while the overlaid APP series is drawn in a neutral tone so the accent line stays dominant.

nodes.name: system-monitor-ribbon.html
nodes.summary: Ribbon template for the System Monitor tab: Audit group with Refresh and Clear Filters buttons, and a Clipboard group with a Copy button disabled when no log records are shown.

nodes.name: system-monitor-view.html
nodes.summary: System Monitor view template: a grid of CPU/GPU/Memory/Network/Disk metric tiles above a log-audit section with a session picker, severity filter chips, free-text search, selection actions, and a shared app-table of log records.

nodes.name: system-monitor-view.scss
nodes.summary: Stylesheet for the System Monitor view: an auto-fit tile grid with fixed row height so sparklines get real vertical space, plus toolbar, severity badge, and log table column styling.

nodes.name: terminal-ribbon.html
nodes.summary: Ribbon template for terminal tabs: Session (new-shell and clear menus), Clipboard (cut/copy/paste), quick Actions (list, open), Locations (home/root), View (scroll lock, scroll-to-bottom, find), and a Tools group opening the Agent panel.

nodes.name: terminal-agent-panel.html
nodes.summary: Template wrapping the shared agent conversation panel in tool-panel chrome for a terminal tab, passing the tab id, active state, and a 'terminal' surface identifier.

nodes.name: terminal-agent-panel.scss
nodes.summary: Sizing-only stylesheet making the hosted agent conversation panel fill the tool panel, deliberately avoiding a display override that would collapse the child's flex column.

nodes.name: terminal-view.html
nodes.summary: Terminal tab view template: an app-terminal pane in the panel-layout center, an eagerly mounted right-edge agent panel (so live agents register with Mission Control even before it is shown), and an on-demand find panel.
nodes.languageNotes: The agent panel mounts hidden rather than lazily so the tab's live agent session exists from tab open, per the panel-layout adoption pattern.

nodes.name: terminal-view.scss
nodes.summary: Small stylesheet letting the terminal pane fill the panel layout's main area on the app background color.

nodes.name: welcome-screen.html
nodes.summary: Welcome screen template: a themed modal (freestanding at cold start, dismissable when summoned) with a decorative accent glow, collapsible Get Started and Tools action groups for creating every tab type, and a searchable, filterable Recent Items list.
nodes.languageNotes: Deliberately uses raw buttons and a bespoke search box instead of the app's control atoms because the welcome look is themed by its own --wl-* palette rather than the form chrome.

nodes.name: welcome-screen.scss
nodes.summary: Large stylesheet theming the welcome modal: an accent-tracking --wl-* palette layered over fixed dark neutrals (with a light-mode re-tune via :host-context), modal presentation variables, glow blobs, action pills, and the recent-items list chrome.
nodes.languageNotes: Aliases --wl-accent to --accent-color so every glow, border, and focus ring tracks the user's chosen accent; overrides the shared modal component's CSS variables from the outside.

nodes.name: configure-dialog.html
nodes.summary: Run Configurations dialog template: a tree-view list with New/Duplicate/Delete controls beside a detail form (name, default toggle, build configuration, target, program, arguments, cwd, environment, debug, and new-window presentation), plus a nested Auto-configure modal parented to this dialog's window.
nodes.languageNotes: The Auto-configure modal is declared inside this dialog's content so it parents to the Run Configurations window and dims it, not the main window.

nodes.name: configure-dialog.scss
nodes.summary: Stylesheet for the Run Configurations dialog: a header/body/actions column where the body splits into a boxed sidebar (toolbar over a scrolling tree) and the detail form, sized so long lists scroll in place instead of growing the window.

nodes.name: directory-host.html
nodes.summary: Template hosting directory views in two phases: a single app-directory-view with a promote-to-worktree handler, or a worktree container that keeps every loaded checkout's view mounted (hidden when inactive) so its state survives checkout switches.
nodes.languageNotes: Inactive checkout sub-views are hidden with CSS rather than destroyed — the same mount-all/hide-inactive invariant the app uses for tabs.

nodes.name: directory-host.scss
nodes.summary: Stylesheet for the directory host: full-height directory views, a hidden modifier for kept-alive inactive checkouts, and a centered 'Opening worktree' loading state.

nodes.name: directory-ribbon.html
nodes.summary: Ribbon template for directory (workspace) tabs — File, Edit, View (layout default/manage/reset/save-as), Solution, and Source Control groups — followed by six modals: busy-run and busy-build stop-and-restart confirmations, Save Layout, Manage Layouts, Delete Layout, and Promote-to-worktree.

nodes.name: directory-ribbon.scss
nodes.summary: Stylesheet for the directory ribbon's modal content: confirmation title/message/actions, the Save As dialog's Default checkbox row, and the Manage dialog's in-place-scrolling preset list.

nodes.name: directory-view.html
nodes.summary: Minimal template for the workspace directory view that renders nothing but the dock container, delegating the entire layout to the dock framework.

nodes.name: directory-view.scss
nodes.summary: Empty stylesheet placeholder for the directory view component, which takes all of its appearance from the dock container it hosts.

nodes.name: debug-panel.html
nodes.summary: Template for the debugger dock panel: a toolbar of run-control buttons (continue/pause, step over/into/out, stop) that toggle on paused state, plus the call stack, variables, and breakpoints sections.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Angular control-flow (@if/@else) to swap the Continue and Pause buttons based on the paused() signal.

nodes.name: debug-panel.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the debug panel covering the run-control toolbar, stack frame rows, variable trees, and breakpoint list within the dock panel chrome.

nodes.name: output-panel.html
nodes.summary: Template for the Output panel: a toolbar with a channel-selection dropdown and a clear button above a host div into which the output view (a terminal-style buffer) is mounted programmatically.
nodes.languageNotes: The output content is not templated; it is attached to the #container element by the component class.

nodes.name: output-panel.scss
nodes.summary: Styles sizing the output panel's host container so the programmatically mounted output buffer fills the panel below its toolbar.

nodes.name: packages-panel.html
nodes.summary: Template for the Packages panel with an Installed/Explore mode toggle: the installed view lists dependencies with update filtering and refresh, while the explore view searches and browses a package registry.

nodes.name: packages-panel.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the packages panel covering the mode toolbars, package rows, version badges, and the explore/search result layout.

nodes.name: problems-panel.html
nodes.summary: Template for the Problems panel: severity filter buttons and an optional source dropdown in the toolbar, live error/warning counters, and a virtualised list of diagnostics that navigate to their location on click.

nodes.name: problems-panel.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the problems panel including severity-coloured counters, diagnostic row layout, and source/location metadata styling.

nodes.name: solution-panel.html
nodes.summary: Template for the Solution Explorer panel: an explorer toolbar with search and expand/collapse, above a virtualised tree view of the solution with per-row icons, git status letters, and context menus.
nodes.languageNotes: Rows are rendered through an ng-template projected into app-tree-view, keeping the tree widget generic.

nodes.name: solution-panel.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the solution panel's tree rows: folder/project icon tinting, bold solution root, and git status indicators.

nodes.name: tree-panel.html
nodes.summary: Template for the File Explorer panel: search toolbar plus a virtualised file tree with type-aware icons, git status letters, changed-folder dots, loading spinners, and row context menus.

nodes.name: tree-panel.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the file explorer tree rows: icon tinting for directories, bold expanded folders, and git status markers.

nodes.name: worktrees-panel.html
nodes.summary: Template for the Worktrees panel: a list of git worktree checkouts with branch labels, duplicate-branch warnings, an inert placeholder row reserved for a future orchestrator agent, and add/remove actions.

nodes.name: worktrees-panel.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the worktrees panel covering list entries, branch sublabels, the dimmed orchestrator placeholder, and warning badges.

nodes.name: agent-chat.html
nodes.summary: Template for the agent chat transcript: a scrollable role=log message list with user/assistant/tool rows, windowed rendering with a 'show earlier' control, and tail-pinning that only a real reader gesture (wheel/touch/key/pointer) can release.
nodes.languageNotes: Reader gestures are listened for separately from scroll events because programmatic tail-pinning raises indistinguishable scroll events; only genuine gestures stop auto-follow.

nodes.name: agent-chat.scss
nodes.summary: Extensive stylesheet for the agent transcript: message bubbles per role, tool-call and result blocks, markdown content styling, the empty state, and scroll/measurement affordances.

nodes.name: agent-composer-shortcuts.html
nodes.summary: Template for the composer's keyboard-shortcuts popover: an icon button triggering a CDK menu panel that lists shortcut groups as plain kbd-key rows with nothing focusable inside.
nodes.languageNotes: cdkMenu must be the ng-template's root node; on an inner element the CDK silently falls back to an inline menu that never dismisses.

nodes.name: agent-composer-shortcuts.scss
nodes.summary: Tiny stylesheet for the shortcuts trigger button, deferring the popover panel's styling to shared menu styles.

nodes.name: agent-composer.html
nodes.summary: Template for the agent message composer: a form with drag-and-drop attachment support, a header showing elapsed run time (paused while awaiting the user), word count, and a context-usage meter, plus the input area, mode/tool controls, and send/edit buttons.

nodes.name: agent-composer.scss
nodes.summary: Large stylesheet for the agent composer covering the header meta row, context meter with warn/high states, attachment chips, the input field, and the control strip of buttons.

nodes.name: agent-conversation-list.html
nodes.summary: Template for the agent conversation history list: search field, filter menu, select-all and bulk-delete toolbar, a new-conversation button, and sortable rows of past conversations with checkboxes and per-row actions.

nodes.name: agent-conversation-list.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the conversation history panel: toolbar layout, search field sizing, filter menu states, row selection highlighting, and metadata typography.

nodes.name: agent-quick-responses.html
nodes.summary: Template for the quick-responses popover: a CDK menu holding a drag-reorderable list of saved replies (grip-handle drag, click to insert, non-dismissing delete buttons) above a text field for adding new responses.
nodes.languageNotes: cdkDragPreviewContainer='parent' keeps the drag preview inside the panel so its class-scoped styles keep applying; the add field stops propagation so the CDK menu's type-ahead does not steal keystrokes.

nodes.name: agent-quick-responses.scss
nodes.summary: Minimal stylesheet for the agent quick-responses component, providing basic layout styling for the quick-response list shown in the agent panel.

nodes.name: agent-tool-strip.html
nodes.summary: Template for the agent conversation tool strip: new chat, stop, compact, an optional Remote Control toggle gated behind a confirmation modal, a grouped provider/model dropdown, attach file/folder/selection actions, scroll-to-bottom, and conversation history.
nodes.languageNotes: Built entirely from app-button/app-dropdown control atoms with per-control aria labels and tooltips; the Remote Control press only opens the confirmation modal — the toggle flips on confirm.

nodes.name: agent-tool-strip.scss
nodes.summary: Stylesheet for the agent tool strip, laying out the button row and the flexible dropdown field that gives way when the strip narrows.

nodes.name: binary-editor.html
nodes.summary: Template for the virtualized hex/binary editor: a fixed offset/hex/ASCII header bar plus a scrollable body that renders only a translated window of rows, with pointer and keyboard handlers for cell selection and caret placement in either the hex or ASCII column.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a sizer/window pattern (full-height spacer plus translateY'd row window) for compressed-scroll virtualization of very large files.

nodes.name: binary-editor.scss
nodes.summary: Stylesheet for the binary editor grid: monospace cell layout driven by a --bpr (bytes-per-row) custom property, header/address/hex/ASCII column alignment, and selection and caret highlight states.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel for the binary-editor component, re-exporting the BinaryEditor component and its public types (BinaryColumn, BinaryEditOp, BinaryRange, BinaryVisibleRange).

nodes.name: code-block.html
nodes.summary: Template for a highlighted code block with a footer showing the language label and action buttons: copy-to-clipboard with a transient 'Copied' state, and an optional run-in-terminal button for runnable snippets.

nodes.name: code-block.scss
nodes.summary: Stylesheet for the code-block component: bordered container, preformatted code area, and the footer row hosting the language label and copy/run actions.

nodes.name: content-host.html
nodes.summary: Template for the tab content host: mounts every open tab's view via ngComponentOutlet and hides inactive ones with CSS (mount-all/hide-inactive), and hosts the document-conflict modal.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the app's mount-all/hide-inactive tab invariant — inactive tabs stay mounted and are hidden with a class rather than destroyed.

nodes.name: content-host.scss
nodes.summary: Stylesheet for the content host, sizing each tab view to fill the host and hiding views carrying the tab-view--hidden modifier.

nodes.name: diff-editor.html
nodes.summary: One-line template providing the host element into which the Monaco diff editor is programmatically mounted.

nodes.name: diff-editor.scss
nodes.summary: Stylesheet sizing the diff-editor host element to fill its container so the embedded Monaco diff editor gets the full available area.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel for the diff-editor component, re-exporting the DiffEditor component as its public surface.

nodes.name: dock-collapsed-strip.html
nodes.summary: Template for the collapsed dock gutter: a tablist of icon+label buttons for each collapsed panel, plus a peek flyout that reuses the docked panel title bar with dock/float/close actions, hosts the panel through a dock-panel-outlet, and offers a drag handle for resizing.

nodes.name: dock-collapsed-strip.scss
nodes.summary: Stylesheet for the collapsed dock strip and its peek flyout: orientation-aware tab layout for vertical and horizontal gutters, active-tab accents, flyout positioning and elevation, and the resize handle.

nodes.name: dock-container.html
nodes.summary: Root template of the dock framework: wraps the layout tree's root dock-node in a cdkDropListGroup and layers the floating-window layer and drag overlay on top.

nodes.name: dock-container.scss
nodes.summary: Stylesheet establishing the dock container as the full-size positioning context for the layout tree, floating layer, and overlay.

nodes.name: dock-floating-layer.html
nodes.summary: Template rendering floating dock panels as absolutely positioned windows: draggable title bar with icon, dock-back and close buttons, panel content via dock-panel-outlet, z-order raised on mousedown, and resize handles on all edges and corners.

nodes.name: dock-floating-layer.scss
nodes.summary: Stylesheet for floating dock windows: elevated bordered window chrome, title bar layout, body fill, and per-edge/corner resize-handle hit areas with matching cursors.

nodes.name: dock-node.html
nodes.summary: Recursive template that renders the dock layout tree: collapsed nodes become collapsed strips, stacks become tab groups, and split nodes render row/column panes with positional splitters, using a self-referencing ng-template to recurse into children.
nodes.languageNotes: Recursion is achieved with a named ng-template invoked via ngTemplateOutlet passing the child node and computed side through the outlet context.

nodes.name: dock-node.scss
nodes.summary: Stylesheet for dock split nodes: flex row/column split layout, pane flex sizing, and modifier states for leaf, collapsed, peeking, end-anchored, and empty panes.

nodes.name: dock-overlay.html
nodes.summary: Template for the drag-to-dock overlay shown while dragging a panel: a drop-preview rectangle, a directional compass of guide targets with hot/disabled legality states, workspace edge targets, and a ghost rectangle following the dragged panel with its title.

nodes.name: dock-overlay.scss
nodes.summary: Stylesheet for the docking overlay: full-surface non-interactive layer, accented translucent drop preview, compass guide placement per direction with hot and disabled states, edge target styling, and the drag ghost.

nodes.name: dock-panel-outlet.html
nodes.summary: Template that dynamically instantiates the registered component for a dock panel id via ngComponentOutlet, falling back to an 'Unknown panel' message when no component is registered.

nodes.name: dock-panel-outlet.scss
nodes.summary: Stylesheet sizing the panel outlet to fill its host and styling the missing-panel fallback message.

nodes.name: dock-panel-placeholder.html
nodes.summary: Template for the dock panel placeholder shown when a panel's content is not yet implemented, rendering the panel's icon, title, and an explanatory note.

nodes.name: dock-panel-placeholder.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the dock panel placeholder, centering the icon, title, and note within an empty dock panel.

nodes.name: dock-splitter.html
nodes.summary: One-line template for the dock splitter rendering only its decorative, aria-hidden grip element; drag behavior lives in the host component.

nodes.name: dock-splitter.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the resizable dock splitter bar between dock regions, including the grip visual and orientation-aware sizing and hover affordances.

nodes.name: dock-status-strip.html
nodes.summary: Template for the per-view status strip showing diagnostics counts and document segments (line/column, word count, read time, language, EOL, encoding, zoom), with comparison views swapping diagnostics for change counts and position.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Angular @if control flow with `as` aliasing to render segments only when the active document reports the corresponding metric.

nodes.name: dock-status-strip.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the dock status strip, laying out grouped clickable segments with compact typography and hover states along the bottom of a view.

nodes.name: dock-tab-group.html
nodes.summary: Template for a dock tab group: a draggable title bar with Auto Hide, Float, Open in New Window, and Close controls, an optional tool strip, and a CDK drag-drop tab strip that hosts panel tabs and group docking.
nodes.languageNotes: Integrates Angular CDK drop lists (cdkDropList with enter predicates) for cross-group tab dragging; mousedown on the rail starts a whole-group drag while tabs carry their own.

nodes.name: dock-tab-group.scss
nodes.summary: Extensive styles for the dock tab group covering the title bar, tab strip, individual tab states (active, hover, dirty, preview), drag previews, tool strip placement, and document-well versus tool-panel variants.

nodes.name: dock-tool-strip.html
nodes.summary: Template for the dock tool strip rendering a row of stubbed icon buttons from the tools input, each with a tooltip and aria-label; click handlers are intentionally absent until panels wire real actions.

nodes.name: dock-tool-strip.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the dock tool strip, arranging compact icon buttons in a horizontal row beneath a panel's title or tab strip.

nodes.name: explorer-toolbar.html
nodes.summary: Template for the shared explorer toolbar combining a search text field with Expand All, Collapse All, and a More Actions button that triggers an app-menu of additional items.

nodes.name: explorer-toolbar.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the explorer toolbar, laying out the search field and action buttons in a single compact row at the top of explorer views.

nodes.name: find-panel.html
nodes.summary: Template for the unified find/replace panel hosted in an app-tool-panel: mode toggle between find and replace, find and replace text fields with Enter/Shift+Enter/Escape keybindings, and Match Case, Whole Word, and Regex option checkboxes.
nodes.languageNotes: Labels wrap the checkbox component's projected native input for runtime association, requiring targeted eslint disables of label-has-associated-control since the lint rule cannot see through the component boundary.

nodes.name: find-panel.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the find/replace panel, arranging the mode toggle, input fields, option checkboxes, and result controls within the tool panel body.

nodes.name: accordion.html
nodes.summary: Template for the accordion form atom: a header button with caret icon and aria-expanded state that toggles a projected content body.

nodes.name: accordion.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the accordion atom's header button, caret icon, and expandable body region.

nodes.name: button-group.html
nodes.summary: Template for the segmented button group atom rendered as an ARIA radiogroup, with each option a radio-role button carrying an optional icon, label, and selected state.

nodes.name: button-group.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the segmented button group, drawing the joined segment row with selected and hover states.

nodes.name: button.html
nodes.summary: Template for the app-wide button atom rendering a native button with icon, loading spinner, label, projected adornments, tooltip bindings, and ARIA attributes for busy, pressed, and labelled states.
nodes.languageNotes: The caller's icon and the loading spinner coexist in the DOM while loading; the stylesheet crossfades between them in pure CSS so the swap causes no re-render.

nodes.name: button.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the button atom covering its variants, sizes, icon and spinner crossfade during loading, label padding rules, and disabled and pressed states.

nodes.name: checkbox.html
nodes.summary: Template for the checkbox atom: a single native checkbox input bound to checked, indeterminate, and disabled signals with a change handler.

nodes.name: checkbox.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the checkbox atom, custom-drawing the checked and indeterminate marks and disabled state over the native input.

nodes.name: dropdown.html
nodes.summary: Template for the dropdown atom using the customizable-select pattern: an explicit button face with color chip and ellipsized label, and options rendered in runs so grouped runs get an optgroup with a visible legend heading.
nodes.languageNotes: In base-select appearance the browser does not paint optgroup's label attribute, so a <legend> first child supplies the visible heading while the attribute remains for assistive technology.

nodes.name: dropdown.scss
nodes.summary: Styles for the customizable-select dropdown: the button face with single-line ellipsized label and color chip, the popover option list, optgroup legend headings, and selected/hover option states.

nodes.name: language-select.html
nodes.summary: Template for the multi-select language picker atom: a native multiple select whose options are generated from the languages input with selection reflected from the value signal.

nodes.name: language-select.scss
nodes.summary: Styles the language-select list box atom: a multi-row select with themed form-control background, squircle corners, and accent-colored border on focus instead of an outline ring.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses CSS custom properties (--form-control-*, --border-radius-multiplier, --app-corner-shape) so the control tracks the app-wide theme and squircle setting.

nodes.name: number-field.html
nodes.summary: Template for the number-field form atom: a single native number input bound to value/min/max/step/disabled signals with a change handler.

nodes.name: number-field.scss
nodes.summary: Styles the number-field atom to the shared control height and themed border/background so it lines up with other single-line controls in a strip.

nodes.name: password-field.html
nodes.summary: Template for the password-field form atom: a native password input with autocomplete disabled, bound to value/placeholder/disabled signals with an input handler.

nodes.name: password-field.scss
